**Source:** `LalKitab.pdf` — a 778-page scan of the English translation (based on the Lal Kitab edition of 1952), transcribed from the embedded text layer with light cleanup. Page markers `**[p. NN]**` refer to the printed page numbers of the original book. Small OCR errors may remain in the dense tables.

### Preface

**[pdf 9-14]**

PREFACE TO BE READ
The study of the positions of celestial bodies and their consequent
cosmic influence/effects on biotic and abiotic entities on Earth in general
and human affairs in particular, may be defmed as astrology.
so
A band of the celestial sphere which extends about to either side
of the ecliptic represents the path of the principal planets, the Moon, and
the Sun. This band of seven celestial bodies which influence human
affairs and personalities are divided into 12 equal parts called signs, each
30° wide, bearing the name of a constellation (a visual formation of stars
perceived as a figure or design, especially one of 88 recognized groups
named after characters from classical mythology and various common
animals and objects) for which it was originally named but with which it
no longer coincides owing to the precession ofthe equinoxes. Dragon's
head (Rahu) and Dragon's Tail (Ketu) are shadow planets, but they have
an astounding effect on the native.
We call names of days in a week in our day-to-day life but most of
us perhaps are not aware that this seven-day system is based on the ancient
astrological perceptions that the seven celestial bodies revolving around
stationary Earth influence what happens on it, and that each of these celestial
bodies control the first hour of the day named after it. This system,
according to western thought, was brought into Hellenistic Egypt from
Mesopotamia, where astrology had been practiced from times immemorial
and where seven had always been a propitious number. In A.D. 321,
Emperor Constantine the Great, grafted this astrological system onto the
Roman calendar, made the first day of this new week a day of rest and
worship for all, and imposed the following sequence and names to the
days of the week: Difs SY.Iis, "Sun's Day"; Difs Ll,nae, "Moon's Day";
Difs Martis, "Mars's Day"; Difs Mercuri0 "Mercury's Day"; Difs lovis,
,
"Jove's Day" or "Jupiter's Day"; Drfs Veneris, "Venus's Day"; and Difs
Satum0 , "Saturn's Day." This new Roman system was adopted with
modifications throughout most of western Europe: in the Germanic
languages, such as Old English, the names of four of the Roman Gods
were converted into those of the corresponding Germanic Gods. Therefore
in Old English we have the following names (with their Modem English
developments and day Lord according to Western/Indian Astrology):
Sunnand<eg, Sunday (Lord Vishnu); MY.nand<eg, Monday (Lord Shiva);

T0wesdreg, Tuesday (the god Tiu, like Mars, was a god of war;
Hanumanji); WYidnesdreg, Wednesday (the god Woden, like Mercury,
was quick and eloquent; Goddess Durga); Thunresdreg, Thursday (the
God Thunor in Old English or Thor in Old Norse, like Jupiter, was lord of
the sky; Old Norse ThYlCsdagrinfluenced the English form; LordBrahma);
Fr0gedreg, Friday (the goddess Frigg, like Venus, was the goddess oflove;
Goddess Lakshmi); and Saetemesdaeg, Saturday (Bhairon).
Lal Kitab was presented to late Dr. Goswami Giridhari La! in 1966
by Major Verma who was posted in the Ministry of Home Affairs for his
research institute on Astrology. As Goswamiji had sound command over
Vedic Astrology, he did not use it for predictions and the book remained
just like any other book in his Astrological collection.
In 1983, Lal Kitab was suddenly in news when an astrological
magazine "Fate and Fortune" published Lal Kitab's remedies in one of its
issues. Soon the market was flooded with Lal Kitabs and its numerous
versions. Although, we have come across a number of reproduction/
versions of Lal Kitab, none of the writers has mentioned as to which
particular issue ofLal Kitab, his work is based on. Some authors have
traced its mythological origin to Aran, the Charioteer of Lord Sun. Others
claim that it is based on some prophesies made to Pt. Roop Chand Joshi by
God. We even have those so-called transcontinental astrologers who have
linked its origin to the Arab/Muslim world.
The oceanic know ledge of occult science is being practiced in the
hilly area of Jammu-Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh where
perhaps this ancient system was given to them by our Holy Saints. The
book is replete with V edic/Sanatan references namely Gayatri Mantra, Stotra,
Gods, Ganga etc. which prima facie rules out its Arab/Muslim origins.
Islam does not talk of Astrology nor relies on its validity. The fact that
colour photographs of all the Lords of nine planets were depicted in 1952
edition again refutes any connection, whatsoever to Islamic Fiqh. We also
have no hesitation in denouncing those who have traced La I Kitabs origin
to mythology. The script of the book and the style used by the author
vindicates our inference.
We would subscribe to the popular and generally accepted view that
the actual author of Lal Kitab was Pt. Roop Chand Joshi who hailed from
Pharwala in United Punjab under British Rule. Panditji was an accountant

in Royal Indian Army during the British Rule. During his tenure in Army,
he received some old manuscripts from one ofhis colleagues who often
ventured into Palmistry. Certain predictions made by the amateur palmist
in respect of his seniors proved meticulously right.
The soldier was encouraged by his seniors to record his knowledge
on paper, which would go a long way in strengthening the faith and trust
of the common man in Astrology and Palmistry. Since the soldier was not
a man of letters, he pleaded with Pt. Roop Chand to translate his acquired
knowledge in black and white. Thus, the foundation of a great book was
laid. The maiden issue which was titled "Lal Kitab Ke Farman" (1939)
was not a comprehensive one and therefore, was not able to acquire
popularity and acceptance among the astrologers and palmists in particular
and public in general.
In a sequel to his maiden work "Lal Kitab Ke Farman", Pt. Roop
Chand Joshi brought out its several issues titled "Lal Kitab Ke Arman".
This book was published in 1940 and was supplement to the earlier book.
In 1941, "Lal Kitab Part ill" was published and gained fame as "Lal
Kitab Gutka". In 1942, "La I Kitab Ke Farman" and after I 0 years of
it (1952), the final work of Pt. Roop Chand Joshi was published in the
name of Lal Kitab which was published after compiling the previous
issues of the books.
The reason that drove us to translate the five issues of Lal Kitab
was our desire to put an end to all controversies cropping up about the
origin of work and its validity. Secondly, since the books were readily
available with us in Urdu language we could endeavour to check
indiscriminate commercialisation in the name of Lal Kitab and also make
efforts to convey to the masses the reality or facts about the original work
in an international language like English.
The first volume of Lal Kitab deals with the grammar of the book.
In the first volume we have dwelt with the grammar of Lal Kitab quoting
illustrations in such a lucid way that even the beginners can make good
predictions. The different states of the planets, items related with them
have been explained through different tables. Father's debt have been
dealt in detail and the remedies for it have been advised accordingly. Readers
are, however, advised to go through the grammar portion (volume I)
thoroughly otherwise they cannot make full use of this field of occult
science.

In the beginning of the book we have discussed the palmistry and
phrenology section in brief which could be used for rectification of the
horoscope while preparing the Annual chart or predicting the natal chart.
Preparation of natal chart through palm have been discussed through which
one can make a natal chart though, date, time, and place of birth of the
native is not available. In this regard we would like to emphasis that before
casting a horoscope through palm one should have good experience in this
field. For some predictions help of phrenology could be taken.
The second volume of the Lal Kitab is all about interpreting the
horoscope, suggesting the remedies by using the grannnar given in the
first volume of the book. Before suggesting any type of remedy for any
evil or debilitated planet, one should see the reason for the problem and
suggest remedy accordingly.
While predicting, one should take care of the planets in their fixed
houses. Suppose Venus is posited in 2nd house, which is its fixed house
and no planet gets debilitated in 2nd house. Its house lord Venus brings
rapprochement and peace. Venus is called reincarnation of Goddess of
Wealth. Here respect for one's spouse will be a beneficial remedy for the
native because Venus is also wife; but if the same Venus is posited in the
House No. 4, fixed house ofJupiter, it will give rise to chances to meet
women, cover up liaisons, flirtations and romance but marital bliss will not
be available. Wealth will be destroyed and children will be few and far in
between. Here the remedy would be establish Moon or throw Jupiterian
things into a well. Have a small pond of water on roof top to end the evil
effect of Venus. Here establishing Moon is recommended because according
to zodiac signs fourth house belongs to Cancer whose lord is Moon and it
is fixed house of Jupiter as per Lal Kitab. To understand this point one
more example can be quoted of House No. II which is fixed house of
Jupiter but as per Zodiac Signs House No.I I belongs to Aquarius whose
lord is Saturn. Hence, it could be said that land belongs to Saturn and
bui Id ing is constructed by Jupiter. Therefore, Saturn must have some impact
over this house.
According to traditional Indian astrology, Rahu & Ketu cannot be
conjoined in position; but only do so by aspect in the latter house where
second evil is posited. For example, if they are posited in H. No. 1 & 7,
they would be considered conjoined in H. No. 7.

This condition of Rahu-Ketu being 1 to 7 from each other does not
hold for a chart based on Oceanic Thought. They can even be together.
Whenever they are separate, wherever they are together by aspect, their
combined effect for that house will be considered. Based on this principle,
their conjoined effect for 12 houses has been given in this part of Lal
Kitab. Knowledge of grammar of Lal Kitab is must given in first part
of the book to understand this volume of Lal Kitab.
Lal Kitab Astrology is very much based on the articles, relations,
business/profession and other miscellaneous things related to the planets
which changes according to the houses of the chart. All the living and
non-living things have been divided by Lal Kitab under nine segments.
Such as brass (Sun), silver (Moon), soil (Venus), Gold (Jupiter), Iron
(Saturn), elder daughter (Mercury) etc. One should bear in mind that
whenever it is indicated that a planet in a particular house has malefic
effect, it would be advisable to refrain from items relating to that planet.
For example, Venus in H.No.9 generally causes financial losses. Hence,
whenever in an annual chart Venus is in H.No.9, if a white cow is purchased,
it will cause heavy losses. Similarly, if items relating to particular house
are established, their benefic or malefic effect will be as per transiting
planet in that year.
A common misconception attributed to some authors of Lal Kitab
in its various forms is that one can establish any planet in his/her desired
house. Nowhere Lal Kitab subscribes to this theory. However, it do
emphasis that "doubtful planet" can be remedied. A planet is considered
'doubtful' if it is posited in a sign other than that (i) the one owned by it;
(ii) or a sign in which it gets exalted or debilitated; (iii) or its fixed house;
(iv) or else it is in company of another planet with which it has house
exchange relationship. The benefit of its 'doubtfulness' can be availed to
obviate its malefic effects. Any planet, which is in house of exaltation or
debilitation, or its fixed house or its own sign, such a planet would have a
pre-determined 'cosmic effect'. It would be futile to make efforts to change
its malefic effects, which is simply beyond human purview.
We would like to underscore that some people take the Lal Kitab's
remedies easy and do not follow them in letter and spirit. The reason
underlying may be that these remedies fall short of their faith and devotion
because some Lal Kitab's astrologers recommend them without proper

knowledge of the grammar of the book or they are not much costly in
comparison to the remedies recommended by the astrologers of different
schools. Secondly some people have apprehension that La I Kitab is not a
part of Vedic Astrology, which is totally wrong. If one really wants to be
benefitted from the Lal Kitab's remedies, one should have faith in their
effectiveness and follow them with devotion as prescribed by their
astrologer.
As Lal Kitabs were written in five parts between 1939 and 1952
AD, some 50-60 years ago, some predictions have been made in the then
contemporary frame of mind. Therefore, it is advised that while predicting
the horoscope, an astrologer should keep in mind the country which the
native belongs, the period in which he was born, and the corresponding
economical, social and political status of the native.
In our work efforts have been made to compartmentalize the rare
aspects found in the five editions available in order to make them accessible
to the masses and the astrologers so that they could make optimum use of
this faculty. In this book we have left a number ofHindi technical terms
related to Palmistry untranslated in English in order to avoid
misunderstanding there actual purport. And to tackle this particular aspect
Sagar Publications have brought out La I Kitab Gutka which is a verbatium
translation of Lal Kitab Part-Ill. As this is more of a translation work
and the Urdu words used in Lal Kitabs have been translated into English
in verbatim.
We would again like to thank our readers for subscribing to our
work and hope that this will go a long way in establishing a common
man's faith in this ancient Occult Science. We look forward to your
valuable suggestions, which we would certainly try to incorporate in our
forthcoming works.

# Part I

## Introduction

**[p. 1]**

**[p. 2]**

2 LAL KITAB
even before testing anything, would not prove helpful for proper
understanding of the subject. Secrets of a subject can be unravelled only
if our approach is positive.
Casting a horoscope and ascertaining its correctness may be attempted
only after understanding of the subject. In the meantime, experience may
be gained from the horoscopes made on the principles of traditional
Astrology. However, trying to understand the subject through one's own
horoscope would prove to be counterproductive
The real friend is one who points out the defects. Pointing out infirmities
of the subject, in fact, would be helpful in augmenting knowledge.
One should refrain from speaking ill of any other expert on the
subject of Astrology. There is no doubt that ill feelings dominate the
polluted minds of men with limited knowledge and foolish satirical kings.
However, it would be humane and kind to give the benefit of the knowledge
of the subject to other friends in good faith; since goodness breeds
goodness.
Prudence demands that one should not take cudgels against destiny.
One cannot author one's own fate. The most auspicious course of life
is the one, which has been pre-ordained. The most powerful, the brave
and the ambitious cannot achieve results despite hectic efforts except
those, which are destined and predetermined. One is, at times astonished
to see marvelous things happening in a few magic moments and one is
left wondering as to what is the secret of this entire marvel. Indeed, the
answer to this is simple. When destiny (Jupiter) shines, a beggar becomes
a king, notwithstanding the fact whether he has the strength where
withal or the need there of.

**[p. 3]**

J
(DIF'FERENCE BETWEEN THE NEW AND
THE OLD SYSTEMS J
La I Kitab makes a fascinating study of Astrology,
lt awakens dormant fortune and gives remedy for doubt,
Its crisp and clear formulations cut matters short,
No constraint of Rahu/Ketu being 7th and birth, sign,
Ascendant is First House, and chart ends at 12. ..
Neither it considers 28 constellations, nor ephemeris,
12 signs are ignored, only 12 Fixed Houses are taken,
Which alongwith 9 planets reveal the Secrets of Luck.
This System is based on Samudrik Shastra. It helps in rectifying
the Ascendant of the horoscope made in accordance with traditional
Astrology. When traditionally, reference is made to three rounds of Saturn's
evil transit of two and a half years each, events like snakebite, collapse
or auction of the house, defects in eyesight, troubles upon paternal uncle
bordering on death or loss of machines should indicate that Saturn is
giving its malefic effects. Alternatively, it could be the sub-period of Sun
in Sun Saturn; or 7-112 years of evil impact of transit of Saturn on Moon
sign. It is better to base one's understanding on firm events rather than
on mere speculation. By correcting the horoscope with the help of
palmistry, supplemented by the knowledge of events of life, Annual Charts
unto 120 years of age can be made with the help of matrix given in the
second part of the Lal Kitab.
In cases of 'doubtful' condition of planets, very simple and
inexpensive remedies have been suggested which have been found to
give results at opportune times.
The subject of Astrology is very vast. Hence, only those issues
have been discussed which are of very serious and grave nature. Instead
of talking of simple fever or minor troubles, it is better to feel concerned
about TB, epilepsy, paralysis; or life or otherwise of a person. In short,
every effort has been made to remove various doubts and apprehensions.
In traditional Astrology, if Rahu (Dragon's head I Ascending Node)
is in the House No.1, Ketu (Dragon's tail/Descending Node) would always
be in the House No.7. Mercury too would be moving around Sun in its
proximity . But such restrictions on planetary positions have not been

**[p. 4]**

LAL KITAB
taken in this treatise. Hence Rahu and Ketu could as well be nearer or
farther, and at times they could even be together. Similarly, Mercury is
not treated as tied with Sun. In fact, each planet has been presumed to
be free to move or take a position of its own and would have its full
distinct individuality, as per Annual chart.
In this system, while analyzing a horoscope, considerations of Signs
and Constellations have been done away with. The Ascendant has been
taken as H. No. 1, and the rest of the Houses are counted next in an anti
clockwise fashion in the order of sequence. However, the position of
planets remains the same as in the traditional chart. The effect of different
planets is read as per their positions in respective numeral houses. There
is no need to resort to lengthy calculations based on ephemeries.
Constellations Signs, Lordship of various Houses are no longer necessary.
The effect of planets is considered by articles, business or relationships
related to them.
For example, if traditional horoscope (north Indian/south Indian/east
Indian/western (Eliropean/American) reads as per charts given below, for
this system it would be read as per example C-II thus the concept
Rashies as distinct from house has been done away. Rectificaion of the
horoscope according to Lal Kitab is explained in the chapter No.7 of
this book alongwith Major Period (Maha Dasha) and Moon Chart.
Traditional (~orth Indian)_ C-1 According_ to Lal Kitab C-II
In place of Sign No. 11 (Acquarius)- House No.1 has been given.
Remaining houses have been numbered sequentially from 1 to 12.
For analysing the horoscope, effects of Rahu No.1, Moon No.2, Saturn
No. 3, Mercury, Mars, Ketu No. 7, Sun No.8, Jupiter, Venus No.9,
would be taken.

18 LAL KITAB
METHOD OF CASTING HOROSCOPE FROM THE HAND
In this part we provide with some curious interpretations of lines in
Astra-palmistry as discussed in the Lal Kitab (Urdu version). Some of the
interpretations are so curious that one hardly believes, but when interpreted
them in actual practice, the results are marvelous and very accurate.
This method is quite different than provided in different works of
Palmistry and needs practice. This may be used in for rectification of
horoscope at the time of transiting of planets in Annual Chart. When any
line starts from an area and ends in another area the planet in which area the
line ends will be found in the relevant House of the Horoscope. As for
example if a line starts from area of Cancer or mount of Moon and ends in
area of Capricorn, Saturn will be found in fourth House. The planets can
be placed on this basis in the horoscope from the hands, but the signs,
symbols and marks must be noted on the different areas of the hands.
When a particular sign has been found in a particular area, that planet will
be found in the same house or Sign. As for example when we find sign of
Jupiter in the Mars area, it will indicate Jupiter is posited in Aries.
No lines have been assigned to Rahu or Ketu. Only signs and marks are
assigned to these shawdowy planets. Where in the palm their sign is
located, these planets would be in that house. If no sign of Rahu 1111 and
Ketu ..... ,..., is located then Rahu would be in House No.12 and Ketu would
be in House No.6 in the natal chart. When fish is found on the hand, Rahu
is found in third or sixth houses and Ketu in ninth or twelth houses which
are known as their places of exaltation. The debilitation signs of Rahu are
ninth or twelth houses where as Ketu in third or sixth houses.
Now we provide a few points and marks which will indicate the position
of planets in different houses of the horoscope with reference to lines and
signs on hand discussed in the coming pages.

hand of the native and would give auspicious results.

**[p. 52]**

52 LAL KITAB
PHRENOLOGY CONNECTED WITH ASTRO-PALMISTRY
The study of the shape, protuberances and mental vibrations of
the skull of a native and the mental capacity and character they reveal is
called phrenology. The strong mental vibrations are controlled by Rahu and
the structure of the brain is controlled by Mercury. From the ear at 90°,
(see Fig. No.3) towards the eyebrows and head, mind is divided into 42
divisions (see Fig No.1). This division of 90° separates forehead from the
mind. The first division is to the right side and the second is to the left side
of the face (see Fig. No.2). Each of the 42 parts is connected with one or
the other planet (please refer to the table on page No .56). ln some cases
more than one planet have a dominant effect over the other planet. These
42 divisions are also twelve houses of the natal chart (See Fig. No.6).
The divisions of the brain are complete at the age of 7 years and it
is presumed that the 7 mounts on the palm had made their place in the natal
chart. At the age of 35 all the planets complete their first circulation. The
structure of the mind is same on the left and right side (see Fig. No.5). The
42 divisions are the 42 years duration of Rahu which controls the mental
vibrations. lt may be noted here that division no. 27 to 42 are the results of
division no. 1-26 which are not given that much importance in the oceanic
kuowledge.
Normally the left side of the brain remain active. However, at the
time of annual transit the right side comes out of its dormant state which
results in some malefic effect. These divisions of the mind are judged from
the palm or the natal chart of the native. The left side of the mind is judged
from the right hand and right side from the left side.
These 12 divisions of the mind are like 12 houses of the natal chart
which are known as signs. The planet transiting those houses of natal chart
activates those impulses or qualities of the mind. The divisions of the mind
are same in the left and right side (See Fig. No.2 and 5). After giving No. 1
to the house of ascendant, 2 to H.No.2 and 3, 4 to other houses in anti
clockwise direction, fix the planets in the 12 division of the mind to judge
the mental vibrations of the native active at that time. For example:
Planet H.No Owner of which mental division

Saturn 8 14 -related to Mars negative thinking everybody
inferior to his ownself

2. When a child is born, his fist is closed. It generally keeps it so and
does not allow anyone to see its palm as if he does not want to
reveal his secrets and the treasure concealed in his tiny fist. The
empty space in the fist is nothing but a replica of the sky. It
contains nothing but air. With the movement of the fist, inside air

comes into motion. Motion produces heat, heat generates fire, fire
produces water, water creates dust, and dust gives birth to Universe.
When the fist is opened, the Palm and the fmgers appear apart.
Separate lines and signs are found on different places and several
parts of the fingers and the palm. They are separate, yet when
blended together, they become one. The palm of the hand is described
as the 'great continent of the land' or 'open universe'. The portions
protruding above like small mountains in a pond are called "mounts".
Lines are like as water rivulets with surging waves moving hither
and thither. Some one of them is named as the line of age the other
one as that of Fortune, and lastly put together and merge and, they
all form an ocean. Hence, this system is called the knowledge
of the ocean.

4. The God Almighty has decreed destiny of a man and scribed it on
his palm. This has been dispatched in such a manner that it is never
lost, neither changes nor forgery could be affected in it, but benefit
can be derived from 'doubtful' ambiguous conditions of planets/
lines. Protruding mounts on the palm help in preventing/
supplementing malefic or benefic effects of each other depending
on their respective height, width and strength. Similarly, the effect/
movement of water (destiny) depends on the depth, cleanliness and
smooth passage in the streams of the rivers (the lines). If the
stream and the river are shallow and narrow, they not only have
less water (luck) but even the speed of their flow (effectiveness)
is also slow. Different signs on the lines are obstacles in the flow
of rivers. The river (line) brings along with it the effect of the soil
while passing through the mountain (mounts). Strong, slow, sweet

Doubts about Birth Time and Intricacies of Combination of
Stars
Planets effect all living beings alike, be it birds, cattle or men etc.
A man's destiny is determined at the time of his birth. He himself
can do very little to change it.
The child comes into the womb of his mother -created and shielded
by supernatural powers, and then it reaches this world from the
closed chamber. The union of the divine and the earth creates
child's breath (life). He gets exposed to the long and tortuous
hypocraisies ofthe world. Duality becomes apparent. Based on the
Knowledge of Palmistry, the course of life can be interpreted with
the aid of Astrology. Doubts, however, arise as to how the lives of
the people born at the same time, whether in the same family or
city or in different _parts of the world, do not follow the same exact

and floods have the same simultaneous effects on thousands born

both systems of knowledge (Astrology and Pahnistry) have been
combined in this treatise to fmd out the results and interpretations.

force of tying together air (Jupiter) and sky (Mercury) that

40 Days of Grace
The effect of benefic or malefic planets cannot come before the
scheduled time and neither can it remain so after due time. However, the
effect of help given by benefic planets can continue even after due time.
40 days of grace from the end of the effect of one planet till the
beginning of another (i.e. even after 40 days after due period), the effect
of malefic planet can still be felt. Generally, benefic and helpful planets
effect can be considered to have started 40 days before schedule. The
cumulative effect would be valid only for 40 days and there would be
no separate effect of 40 days for each of the planets. These are called
40 days of grace. On this basis, 40 days after the birth of a child and
40 days after the death are observed with piety.

18. Measure of Strength in Case of Confrontation of Remedy
The comparative strength of all planets in the descending order is
Sun, Moon, Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.
When a planet in transit or being posited in First H. gets into confrontation
(whether inimical or friendly) with any other among the remaining
8 planets, then Sun's strength would be 9/9, and Moon 8/9, Venus 7/9,
Jupiter 6/9, Mars 5/9, Mercury 4/9, Saturn 3/9, Rahu 2/9 and Ketu
1/9. This measure of strength would be helpful in measuring increase or
decrease of effect as a result of 'confrontation', as well as for the
measure of remedy of any planet and the time of remedy.
19. State of Planets-Planet Effect (Fixed)
and Sign Effect (Doubtful)
A planet is considered of 'doubtful' affect if it is posited in a sign
other than (i) the one owned by it; or (ii) a sign in which it gets exalted
or debilitated; or (iii) its fixed H.; or (iv) else it is in company of another
planet with which it has H. exchange relationship. The benefit of this
'doubt' can be availed to obviate its malefic effects. Contrary to this, if

it is in H. of exaltation or debilitation, or its fixed H., or its own sign,
such a planet would have 'planet effect' which would have been

its malefic effects. It would rather be beyond human strength. Only a
few Gods' men may have the ability to alter the course of destiny. That
too would be limited to a state of exchange, meaning erasing another
animate or worldly thing or strength from its existence and exchanging
it with an another animate, worldly thing or strength. Even then, no new
numbers can be created accepting at a time when such personalities are
prepared to destroy themselves or their own strength in their efforts to
ward off trouble for others. This condition would be like a divine effort.
Something cannot be created from nothing. It can be mere exchange. If
we call planetary effect (fixed) as king, sign effect (doubtful) would be
like the Minister. To obviate malefic effects of planets, some remedies
have been suggested later.
20. 35 (Thirtyfive) Year Circulation
All planets complete one round of transit in 35 years circulation.
Those planets, which give malefic effect in the first round, would not do
so in their second period of round after 35 years. But that does not mean
that they must give benefic effect. This circulation period of planets is
called 35-year circulation.

22. Ruling Planet of Birth Day!finle
The ruling planet of birthday would be 'Birthday Planet'. The ruling
planet of the time when birth takes place would be Birth Time Planet.
The names of days like the planets of the week are Sunday (Sun),
Monday (Moon), Tuesday (Mars), Wednesday (Mercury), Thursday
(Jupiter), Friday (Venus), and Saturday (Saturn). Every evening is 8th
Rahu and every dawn- 9th Ketu. According to British system next day
start from 12:00 hrs midnight, but in this system, next day starts from
the time of sunrise.
23. Tinling of Planets in One Day
The first part of the day after sunrise is called the time of Jupiter.
After morning till noon, it is time of Sun. The Moon -lit night is time of

**[p. 79]**

HOUSES AND PLANETS 79
Moon. Midnight would be Venus time. Peak of noon is of Mars. After
full noon's day but before peak evening, would be Mercury time. Pitch
dark night or looming black clouds would be Saturn time. Peak evening
but before night would be Rahu's time. The dawn (before sunrise) would
be Ketu's time.
24. Mutual Relationship of Planets in Accordance with Birthday
and Birth Time with Reference to Day of Birth and Time of
Birth.
(i) The planet of birthday is considered as the fortune-raising planet (in
fixed H. of day planet). It is 'doubtful' and can be remedied. The
planet of birth time is called planet of luck. It is of 'planet result'
(benefic or malefic) and no remedy is feasible. Planet of birth time
would be treated to be in the fixed H. of the birthday planet.
(ii) For example, if birth is on Monday and birth time is peak evening,
the concerned day planet would be taken as Moon and the planet
concerning time would be Rahu. Now planet of birth time will be
considered to be in the fixed H. of the said planet of birthday. That
is, now Rahu (planet of birth time) would be in H. No.4 (which is
fixed H. of Moon-planet of Birthday). As the concerned planet
concerning birthday would be remediable, thus for Rahu No.4,
articles, business relations concerning H. No.4 will not give malefic
effect with respect to H. No. 4. If it does give malefic effects the
same can be turned into benefic with the remedy provided for

as debilitated, even Mars would be Mars (negative) and Rahu too would
be malefic (irrespective of position of Rahu and Mars and even if they
enjoy high and exalted position).
27. Blind Planets
If H. No.1 0 is being vitiated due to mutual enmity of posited planets
or debilitated planets, then that horoscope would comprise of blind planets
and all planets, including Saturn itself even posited in exaltation Hs.,
would give results like the blind (for details see Saturn in H. No. 10).
28. Half-Blind Planets
These are such planets, which are like the human beings which can
see during the day but become blind at the night. For example, if a chart
has, fourth Sun and seventh Saturn, it would be called a chart of half
blind planets.
29. Pious Planets
Saturn, Rahu and Ketu are three evil planets, but Rahu and Ketu in
H. No.4 swear before Moon that they would abandon sin. Saturn in H.
No. II in obeisance to Jupiter decides about the sins committed by Rahu
and Ketu. That is to say, ifRahu or Ketu be in H. No.4 or any other H.
along with Moon, and Saturn is in H. No. II or any other H. with Jupiter,

**[p. 81]**

HOUSES AND PLANETS 81
in such a chart both Rahu and Ketu will not give malefic effects. All
other planets would be pious I religious, but that does not mean that evil
planets in such a condition will definitely give benefic results. The certainty
is only to the effect that they will not commit sins (give malefic results).
30. Companion Planets
When planets are posited in exchange relationship by virtue of their
designated sign or in houses in which they get exalted or are united
though their roots with respect to their fixed houses, they are called
'companion planets'. For example, Sun's fixed H. is No.5 and that of
Saturn is No.IO. Now if Saturn be in No.5 and Sun in No.lO then both
are called 'Mutual Companion Planets', (and would give results like
conjoined/joint planets). The dividing line of each House of the Chart is
porous for neighboring planets if they are friendly, but it keeps the enemy
planets apart. Friendly planets posited in adjoining houses also become
companions. They will not harm each other, but two enemies in adjoining
houses would be kept apart by the dividing lines.
31 . Planets in Confrontation
If friendly planets are so posited that either or all of them get
polluted through their roots by an enemy planet, then they would be
called to be in a state of confrontation.
32. Scapegoats of Planets when Under Assault by Enemy Planets
When planets come under assault from enemies, then instead of
their taking or beating themselves, they make scapegoats of other planet
to save their skin.
Saturn
To protect itself against the enemy planets, Saturn has commissioned
Rahu and Ketu as agents who scout and expose sacrificial goats in the
place of Saturn. Rahu and Ketu together are considered as artificial
Venus. Thus, when Saturn is in trouble from Sun, then in its own place,
it will get Venus (wife) damaged. (In Saturn-Sun confrontation, the wife
gets affected). Neither Sun nor Saturn would let itself be destroyed since
both are father and son. For example, Sun being in H. No.6 and Saturn
in H. No.l2 would mean that such a man would keep losing his wife one
after another.

Mars
Mars (positive/brother) passes its troubles to Ketu (son). The lion

son after son or nephew (Ketu) would be killed.
Venus
Venus (woman) is of diabolical nature. It would drag its own

Jupiter
Jupiter has kept its fiiend Ketu for sacrifice. For example, if Jupiter

offspring/represented by H. No.5 would not be effected. Instead, maternal
uncle will suffer for 7 years (period of Ketu).

onto Ketu.
Moon

Rahu & Ketu

33. Religious Places
A religious place is one, which is the sacred place for worship. For
Muslims it is Mosque, for Sikhs-Gurdwara, for Christians-Church, for
Hindus-Temple. And for all (including atheists), flowing water of a river
water-stream a crossing where 4 paths cross or energy is for Saturn
would serve as Religious Places.
34. Alive Planet (Unaffiicted)
A planet is alive if it is upright in all respects and has its own clear
effect without the polluting effect of any enemy planet (i.e., through
ownership of any sign having any enemy's effect or due to pollution of
its house, due to aspect of enemy planet or company of an enemy
planet).
35. Planets in Its Own House
A planet positioned in its own sign, for example, Mercury in H. No.
3 and 6.
36. Planet of a Fixed House
A fixed house (in accordance with the list) for the purpose of
friendship-enmity-equality, exaltation/debilitation will be called that planet's
House. For example H. No.7 for Mercury.
37. Friendly Planet-Enemy Planet
In accordance with list of friendship -enmity-equality, planets are
friends\ enemies as in the list. Their friendship/ enmity would not be
through any other means. The list of exaltation, debilitation, and equality
per section and as per fixed houses is given separately. An exalted planet
would mean the one, which has full 100% capacity to give results. A
debilitated planet would mean one whose strength has been completely
or partially damaged. An even I equivalent planet would mean the one
which has even strength.
38. Adult and Non Adult Planets

accepted that there is no change in the line after 21 years. A child's lines
though not fully reliable are considered probable. If the closed fist of a

3. Rahu/Ketu
Rahu is shown as H. Lord of No.l2 and also gets debilitated in the
same. Rahu gets debilitated when in H. No.l2 of Jupiter despite the fact
that Jupiter and Rahu both are not outward enemies but are equal. Jupiter
becomes dormant in company of Rahu. Rahu is known as sky
(H. No.l2) of blue colour. When the air of Jupiter gets the support of
sky, it becomes lighter (as air rises, it becomes thinner) and useless for
people to breathe, but when the same Jupiter's rare air comes down
below, it comes close to Ketu (H. No.6) and is helpful for everyone. On

with mutual support, both will give excellent results. While both in H.
No.6 will give exalted result, either or both in H. No.l2 will give malefic
results. If we suppose Rahu is treated like an artificial Sky, it would tell

world below me or in the unknown world, above me". It means that
Rahu would push Jupiter on either side of these two worlds. Jupiter
when in the company of Rahu, it remains the master of one side of the
world, whether human or the unknown. That is the meaning of Jupiter
remaining dormant.
In this way, when Ketu is with Mercury or in H. No.6 ofMercury
it would be debilitated but when Ketu gets the support of Jupiter, it will

Hs.) is in exaltation, Rahu would be debilitated in these houses. This is

House H. No.1 to 6 of the chart are considered to be the prior side
and Nos.7 to 12 are called the latter side. If there is no planet on the prior
side, the latter side (Nos.7 to 12) is deemed to be dormant but when
latter side is blank, the first side would be dormant. Anyway, the effect
of dormant planet would not go to next house. A house which has a
planet in it would be treated as active. A planet in its own house (for
example Venus in H.No.7 or Mars in H.No.3) will under all conditions be
deemed as awake. When there is no planet in the prior Hs. (Nos. 1 to
6), planets of the other H. (No. 7 to 12) would be deemed as dormant.

awakening the fate and if the latter houses are blank, it would be necessary
to identify remedy to awaken the House which is blank (awakening of
planet and of H.No. are two separate things). 1f a dormant planet awakens

of general age of such awakened planet (for example Mars 6, Ketu 3

planet would pollute effect of other planets irrespective of friendship or
enmity.

120 LALKITAB
Aspects of Planets and Relationship with Houses
In order to understand this, let us consider a sign as a woman and
planet as a man. The unification of planet and sign of the two or man
woman relationship prevails in the blank celestial Gemini Sign of Mercmy
because of family love of Venus in the Trinity of the world (3rd house of
Mars). The temper of this couple may be considered as divided into three
parts;
1. The lordship/ownership of the house or simple relationship of a man
and a woman.
2. Of exalted condition which is beneficial for one and another.
3 . Debilitated or inimical condition full or enmity or harming each other.
The effect of the ruling planet of each sign may be normal, exalting
or debilitating whether for the sign or the planet. If a planet in transit goes
to another sign, it would give its effect in transit as if it were originally
posited in that position (sign).
Suppose the 12 houses of the horoscope are like the 12 little rooms
of a big house. Consider each line of house as the wall of the room. It
can be seen that the inside four houses of the chart are 4 rooms with 4
walls. They are also considered to have brought along with them the
treasure of destiny. The rest of eight houses are 8 triangles of Y2 houses
with three walls each and these 8 half houses form the other half (4 full
houses) of the chart. A child has full eight houses. The first house is of
his birth and body and the eighth house is of death. The planets may be
taken as lamps. The doors of all the rooms are open from some side or
the other. The light of burning lamp (a planet) in a house is considered to
be going to the other house from its door. This going of light to another
house is called the aspect of the planet. In this treatise, when a reference
is made that a planet from its own house aspects the planet of 7th house
with 100%, 50%, or 25% of its strength, it would mean that, it much
aspects the latter house or that much effect of its own house goes to the
house which comes latter. This does not mean that it is dragging the effect
of the 7th house following its own into its own house. The H. No. 8 (the
house of death) aspects inversely i.e., it sends its own effect to House
No. 2. This H. No. 2 is the joint seat ofRahu and Ketu (as the place of

**[p. 121]**

PLANETARY ASPECf 121
sins and righteous actions) but in this H.No. 2, the effect coming from
H. No. 8 is of all evil planets viz. Rahu, Ketu and Saturn. They cause
havoc every Sth year.
The planets of houses can aspect the respective 7th house from
their position (3rd aspects the 9th but the 9th cannot aspect the 3rd). In this
way, 6th aspects the 12th but the 12th cannot put its effect in the 6'h
excepting Mercury in H. No. 12. Mercury is considered to be the sky
and House No. 6 is infernal subterranean. In H. No.l2 is the sky and
blank space. Every 7th year can bring about a change in the situation. 1n
H. No.8 of death planet of the house aspecting backward can bring about
change in situation after every eighth year. The house aspecting the 7th
after one's own are the following:
House No. 3 aspects H.No.9
House No. 6 aspects No.12
House No. 8 aspects H.No. 2 (through inverse sight).
The planet of Mercury has separate story. In short, Mercury
aspecting H.No.9 from H.No. 3 or Mercury posited in H.No.9 or Mercury
H.No. 12 aspecting H.No.6 renders the effect of all planets meaningless;
whether those all on one side and Mercury alone is in confrontation;
whether they are its friends or enemies; whether they are with it or on a
different confrontation with it. The House No.8 aspects backward. On
this principle No.8 aspects H.No.2 with 100% aspect, H.No.2 aspects
H.No.6 by 25%. Thus, 25% effect ofNo.8 would go to H.No.6, H.No.6
aspects No.12 (100%) and thus 25% effect ofNo.8 goes to No.12 via
H.No.6 Thus by inference H.No.2 aspects No.l2 by 25%.
Difference Between 100% Effect of Aspect on Latter 7™ House
The house having 100% aspect creates its effect in the 7th house
like sugar and milk. The seventh house creates the opposite effect in it
next house i.e., it poisons the house next to it. In both conditions, the
effect of aspect is 10 0% but the difference is that the houses having 100%
effect are the inside houses, centric H.Nos. 1. 4, 7 and 10. The houses
following them are the houses of the outside triangles. Inside the centric
houses, the principle of the 7th from own position does not apply. It will
also not work for 100% effect on the next houses for benefic results.

**[p. 122]**

122 LALKITAB
When a planet aspects a house latter than its own with 100% aspect,
then the effect of aspecting planet gets mixed with the 'aspected' planet
(not the house) in such a way as sugar mixes in mille Such a mixing is
called the mixing of Mercury. The effect of the aspecting planet will remain
the same as it was in the house in which it is posited but when any planet
aspects the House No. 7 the effect of aspecting planet in that house (not
in the planet) will get mixed in such a way that a person with one leg gets
a leg of another. Such working together of two things but keeping their
identities intact is called the mixing of Mars. That is, the effect of aspecting
planet (of the earlier house) would be quite inverse for the aspected
(following one). If the aspecting planet had benefic effect in house of
position, that benefic effect, after meeting with the latter house would
become malefic for the latter house but the effect of earlier planet would
remain the same for itself.
Effect of a Planet on another Planet and Effect of the House of
other Planets and Difference thereof
The meaning ofmixing of effect of a planet (of earlier house) with
the planet (of the latter house) would be that the effect of the planets in
latter house would become the same but this mixing does not mean to
have any effect in the latter house as such (effect only on planet and not
on the house). It is possible that there may be several planets in that latter
house. When the effect ofthe planet of the earlier house gets mixed with
the planets of the latter houses only, it is possible that all planets in the
latter houses are its friends but it is possible that when:-
(i) the 'poison' of the planet of earlier house gets mixed, then all of
them or a few of them do not get together or may become even, or
some may remain enemies.
(ii) the effect of mixing may result in friendliness in case of some which
were earlier inimical.
When we refer to mixing of effect of earlier planet with the latter
house (and not the planet), it would mean that the planets of the latter
house would remain as separate but despite being separate, they would
give the proof (effect) of that mixing of Martian type. That happens so,
because the nature of the house itselfhas been changed for all the planets
posited in the latter house (i.e., H.No. for them has got changed) and they

**[p. 123]**

all give different effect for aspects relating to that house but when the
planet posited in the subsequent house is affected by mixing, its own effect
gets changed. The effect of change would be on the items of the changed
house. If there were many planets, the planets whose effect gets changed
would give changed results only on those things, which are concerned
with the planets in those houses. For example, the fixed house of both
Mercury and Venus is H. No.7 in which effect ofH.No.l canjoin from

will not be malefic. Instead of being exalted in its own first house, the

an example of I 00% aspect.
In another example, supposing Venus is in H. No.6 and Mars is in
H.No. 12. For purpose of aspect, 6th H. and 12th H. are 7th from each other.
In such a case, effect of Venus in H. No.6 will be quite opposite on

auspicious) will go to H.No. 12 where Mars is situated. When effect of

in H. No.12 will be positively affected. The brother of the native (Mars)
would have an excellent effect in form of worldly comforts but Venus of

In short, in case of 100% mixing, the native will be personally
effected (benefic/malefic) but the effect of aspect on the 7'h will be as
given above. It will not have a straight effect on native. For example, in
the subsequent house, if there is Venus as a result of 7th adulteration, there
will be opposite effect on Venus. Its opposite effect will be on the in-laws
of the native. Ifthe first house is giving malefic effect to the native, the
inverse of that malefic effect would be benefic. The concerned relative
of the planet of native, who may be having relations with the native of
the planet of the latter house, if there is Mars, would mean a brother, if it
is Mercury, then it would mean a sister.

## Chapter 6 · Debts/Complicated Planets

**[p. 132]**

If a planet in 9th is in conjuction with Mercury through root.
It indicates ancestor'slfather's Debt, nullifies effect of all planets.
When a companion cuts the roots, that conceals the aspect.
Malefic planets in House No.2, 5, 9 and 12 indicate Father's Debt.
If a planet in 3rd is connected through root to latter Mercury,
It will destroy both the houses, whether friendly or not.
If Mercury be with it, 3rd would not be malefic, but changed.
A person having 'debt' will suffer from day of his birth or from a
particular day. He will constantly and steadily face bad days for years and
would not be able to face the rigors of time and keep up the circle of
his life. The effect of sins of male elders on the native is called 'Father's
Debt'. The sin would have been conunitted by some one, but the
punishment would be inflicted on his progeny.
'Father's Debt' would be indicated in a horoscope, wherein an enemy
planet has an evil effect on a planet while posited in the sign of the planet
and connected to it through root, is itself polluted. General symptoms of
such a situation are reflected in the horoscope of grandfather, father, son
and brother when a malefic planet recurs in the same house or such
other houses where that planet is counted as fully malefic. For example,
Rahu in House No.I I, Saturn House No.4 or House No.6, Mercury in
House No.2, 3, 8, 11 or 12 may appear again in the horoscopes of such
a family.
In reality this condition is reflected by the planets of House No.9.
Planets in House No.9 (House of Jupiter) singly or jointly or being
mutually antagonistic, spoil the power of Jupiter by mixing poison in the
effect of Jupiter. Rahu is considered as the silencer of Jupiter. If it
silences Jupiter, by being in Jupiter's houses or in fixed houses of
Jupiter, it would reflect burden of Father's Debt.
In the same way, other planets too indicate debt. Deterioration in

Remedy of Debt to Elders
In case of elders' Debt, a sin is committed by the elders and its
result is to be borne by the present generation causing thereby damage
to the things relating to the planet, relative or business to such an extent
where a stage of total extinction may be reached. At such a time, all the
family members or their blood relations such as daughters, grand daughters,
wife, sisters, grandsons, grandfathers and forefathers (in short wherever
the blood relationship extends) all have to contribute in the remedy,
which would not only be helpful but also necessary. For a woman's
parents (in-laws of native) there would be no requirement of contribution
in the remedy of debt to elders but the contribution by native's daughters,
sisters, sons or their children (whether male or female) is not only
justified but also necessary. If for some reason, it is not possible or there
is any doubt, it would be preferable that they too are made partners. In
case any relative cannot contribute for some reason or due to infidelity
or personal estrangement, it is necessary to apprise him that such a debt
to the elders or the dirty burden on the family (like leprosy) would
continue to flow in the veins ofthe family's members living away from
the family. It would be the duty of the family members doing such a
remedy to contribute their shares also along with his own but their shares
wonld be ten times than the general share i.e., ifthe general share is one
rupee, the share of such a misguided one would be ten rupees.

The period of continued vicious state of a planet would be Major
Period and only one planet can be in full Major Period in the span of
35 years of life and such a period of 'eclipse' in a man's fate can extend
to maximum 39 years in total life time of a person. The intervening
period of two Major periods (one MP expires and the other starts)
would not have the malefic effect of Major period.
(i) Wherever a planet is posited if that house is taken as the 1st, from
there, 4th or 8th house would be considered for Major Period.
The duration of Major Period would be Jupiter 16 years, Sun-6
years, Moon-10 year, Venus-20 years, Mars-7 years, Mercury -17
year, Saturn 19 years, Rahu 18 years, Ketu 7 years. Total 120
years.
(ii) Planets of destiny (ii) sign effect (doubtful) (iii) exalted, (iv) alive
and (v) benefic are never in Major Period.
(iii) There would never be Major Period of any planet if there is some
planet in any of the Centric Houses (No. 1, 4, 7 or 10) and there
is no exalted planet in the other houses like Moon in House No. 9,
Rahu in House No.3, Mercury and Rahu in House No.6, Ketu in
House No.9, Venus and Ketu in House No. 12, Moon in House No.
4 or Moon itself be benefic.
(iv) During Major Period, Planet of deceit would create 'changed
conditions' every 7th year through Rahu and every 8'h year through
-planet in House No. 8.

## Chapter 8 · Helpful Remedies

**[p. 158]**

In the Soul-idol conflict, if a planet is taken as the 'soul' and sign
as 'Idol' there is no scope for any remedy for the planets of 'fixedresults'
The remedy of sign or a planet of doubtful nature, of sign effect or deceitful
planets has been considered humanly possible. The expensive stone of
Mercury (emerald) cuts and kills all, but itself is vulnerable to the soldering
metal which is also an item of Mercury. In this way, the evil (Rahu-Ketu
Satum) planets strike against all planets but in order to neutralize the sinner
planets their own sin becomes effective. Ketu's remedy will render the
malefic effect of Rahu as benefic and vice versa. In Brief, the remedy
for evil planets (Rahu-Ketu-Saturn) is to bring up, breed or look
after, cultivate and donate items relating to them. It will be helpful
to get their blessing or seek their pardon. For example, items
concerning Venus are cows, food of a common man or mixed cereals.
For seeking help of Venus' give one's share of food to the cow. During
Crow Line on palm, in order to save loss of wealth, (time of malefic effect
of Saturn), give one's share of bread to the crow, give food to sister's
son to seek benefit in getting progeny (Ketu)
There are two planets in the 'artificial condition' of every planet.
Whenever any planet becomes malefic, for achieving benefic results,
malefic constituent of that planet may be removed which would lessen
the effect of the planet and render it benefic. For example, if Saturn is
malefic, remove Jupiter from its artificial condition of Saturn (Venus
Jupiter). If Mercury is established, Jupiter will disappear and Venus will
remain. Now with Venus in combination with Mercury, Saturn will start
giving benefic results. The remedy of each fixed planet will be taken in
accordance with 'Lal Kitab' which is discussed in this chapter- Remove
that component of artificial combination which is giving malefic results.
When Venus gives malefic results Rahu may be removed from its artificial
equivalent Rahu-Ketu (Venus), leaving Ketu only. That is to say, improve
Rahu to get benefic effect of Venus. In order to keep Mercury- Jupiter
combination active, keep yellow coloured things of Jupiter (gold ornaments)
folded in green paper, that will prove helpful. for combined Mercury-

**[p. 159]**

HELPFUL REMEDIES 159
Venus-Saturn one piece each of the bread from one's food be given to
cow, crow and black dog. It would render benefic and excellent results
for respect, wealth and progeny. In fine, remove the things giving malefic
results so as to neutralize malefic effect of that planet.
Remedy of Mars Negative
For removing malefic effect of Mars negative, the skin of deer will
help. Mars+ Mercury= Mars negative. The poison of the snake of Satnrn
or joint Mars+Mercury and Satnrn can be remedied by the skin of the
deer in which the poisonous snake will not come. A dead deer is a friend
of Mars negative.
(i) The defect of uncontrollable camel would be apparent from its nails
because it does not have heart (Moon). The nails of the feet of camel
(Ketu) get punislmlent for the camel. The camel would be controlled
by eliminating the malefic effect of Ketu. Moon's worship as per its
position would be helpful. Moon is the master of age and is kind on
everyone. Mars negative carries the signal of death. Hence wherever
there is Moon, there would be no Mars negative. Whenever there is
Mars negative, there would be no Moon. On this principle, the
remedy of Mars negative is to worship of Moon. The evil effect of
Mars negative can be removed by baiting sweet bread in the
oven and then giving the sanie in charity.
(ii) The malefic effect of Ralm can be removed by storing barley in a
red cloth in a closed space under pressnre. Or else wash barley in
milk and throw in running water. If one is bothered by T .B. or long
fever, barely should be washed in cow's nrine and sealed in red cloth.
The teeth may be washed with cow's nrine.
(iii) The effect of a malefic planet can be removed through things allied
to a planet in exaltation (by worship).
(iv) Let us have a look at what is concealed in deceptive planets and
their remedy. If birth of a son (Sun) or daughter (Mercury) gives
malefic effect to the father, a piece of copper round the neck of the
son/girl would be auspicious. This would neutralize Mercury.
(v) If any two of evil planets (Ralm-Ketu or Satnrn) are together, it would
be auspicious to establish Mars, provided Mars is of Sign Effect

provided Mercury is not in H.No. 3, 6, 7 or 9. Otherwise Mars
would be helpful. In short, make sure at the time of considering the
remedy through a planet that it should not be of Planet Effect
(irremediable).
(vii) The remedy for planets of House No. 9 would be through the colour

Period of Remedy
The period should be for a minimum of 40 days and 43 days at the
maximum. For family remedy (for father's debt or mother's debt etc.)
the period ofremedy instead of daily, can be made weekly (i.e. 40 to 43
weeks, once a week). If a remedy is discontinued/forgotten even on
last day 39th or 40'", all labours done would be wasted. Start afresh
and complete (4 0/43) the whole period. If the remedy is required to be
discontinued, but its effect is to be maintained, rice washed with milk be
kept along with you till they are started afresh.
Helpful Remedy as per the Birthday and Birth Time
For example:- If the day of birth is Monday and time is late evening,
the day planet shall be Moon and the Time Planet would be Rahu. The
planet of birth time would be written in the concerned Fixed House of the

**[p. 165]**

HELPFUL REMEDIES 165
planet ofbirth day (see chapter 2). In this case, Rahu (which is the planet
of the birth time) would be in H.No. 4 which is fixed house of Moon (the
planet of the day). The planet of the birthday (doubtful) is remediable but
there is no remedy for planet of birth time. In this case, whenever and
whatever are the effects of House No.4 would be of Sign Effect which
would improve with the remedy of Moon. Rahu would be of Sign effect
at the time of giving malefic effect on the items of House No. 4 of that
person, whether that planet (of birth time) may not be of sign effect but,
if the planet of Birth time (as per the birth in accordance with the above
example) in the specific houses of each planet come within Sign effect
the given remedy would be useful, for which changed or remediable planet
of birthday would be taken and not of birth time. For example, if anybody
is born after sunrise of Tuesday and in the first part of the day (at the
time of Jupiter) the birth time (Jupiter) planet would be in House No.3 of
Fixed House of Mars. Supposing, now Jupiter in H.No.3 creates disease
relating to Mars, it would be of Sign Effect which is counted as planet of
birthday but Mars is of Sign Effect in H.No.4 and 6 even then in such a
condition, the general remedy of Mars would be helpful and the remedy
for Jupiter would not be advantageous.
Remedy of Planet
1. No remedy is possible for Planet Effect which is fixed for all time
but sign effect (doubtful condition) would be remediable.
2. Remedy is to be done dnring day time (8 AM. to 4 PM.). Night is
under the command of Saturn and any remedy done at night may
tum hazardous.
3. The period of remedy is 40 days at the least and 43 days at the most.
There is no condition of any particular day to start the remedy.
4. In the process of remedy if any negligence or discontinuity takes
place, (it may even be 39th day) the entire labour goes waste lost
and the remedy is to start afresh.
5. Any blood relation can do the remedy.
6. When planet is posited in another house, remedy of fixed House Lord
will remove malefic effects of that planet. For example, Saturn No.
9 or 11 or Rahu H.No. 9 or I 1. Fixed House Lord is Jupiter.
Treatment of Jupiter will help. If Mercury is in H.No.3, Mars is
presumed to be in its Fixed House Lord. Treat Mars for removing

I. The lordship of houses, fixed houses, houses of exaltation and
debilitation have been fixed for all planets. To counter their effects,
planets be considered like lighting lamps in the houses of Signs. One
lamp giving light to the other lamp produces changes in the effect of both
the lamps. For example, the lamp of the Sun whose colour is wheatish
brown and if with it, another lamp of Jupiter whose colour is yellow be
lighted, the colour of the combined lights of both the lamps, would
together be apparent in life, as regards human fate. With these changes,
there would certainly be variegated spectacles in the field of fate. When
one lamp extinguishes, the effect of the planet finishes or when it begins
to bum the effect of the planet begins or in one house, another planet
(lamp) begins to glow. However, there would be no difference in their
scheduled lordship of these houses. It would mean that each planet has
a permanent scheduled house with regards to ownership, fixed house,
exalted or debilitated condition, irrespective of the fact that planet may
go as a visitor to another house. The schedule of such transit of a planet,
signifies the timing of the lighting of the lamp. Strength of the planet
means candle power of the lamp.

Identifying Planet of Strength
The planet attributed to a person will work for him in House No.9
notwithstanding the fact that such a planet may be posited elsewhere in
the horoscope. (the planet belonging to a man and the planet belonging
to the place has been dealt separately).
Any person possessing more strength of a planet will not habitually
use things connected with that planet. For example, Sun is considered as
salt (white) and Mars as sweet. A man with strong Sun will not use too
much salt. In this way the man dominated by Mars will not be too much
used to sweet things. He will be habituated to make too much use of salt.
With weak Mars, he would be useing more of sweet things.
Effect of Planets on the 2"d Generation or Relatives
(i) When someone's Jupiter seems strong enough, the house in
which Jupiter is posited, the allied items of that house of the person, will
have the attributes of Jupiter. If Jupiter is in its own houses or in
fixed houses, his grand father and father will experience the same
condition as related to the position of Jupiter. In this way other planets
also work.
(ii) If someone's Sun is strong enough, but is in the House No.6
ofKetu, that person's son (Ketu) will have dominating attributes of Sun.
(iii) If Ketu lies in fixed House No.3 of Mars, one's brother will
have the attributes of Ketu.
Effect of Joint Planets
Joint planets are not malefic in the centric houses. They give their
individual effects in H.No.2. (temple) and No.ll (religion).
(i) When Jupiter-Sun, Jupiter-Mercury, Jupiter-Saturn, Sun-Mercury,
Sun-Saturn, Mercury-Saturn are conjoined, they will not have any effect
of the parental comfort and ancestor's property. It will only mean worldly
comforts of the person, irrespective ofthe fact that all these planets may
individually have different types of relations with their related things or
business or the related planet's links.

the degree of aspect i.e., 100%, 50% or 25%. The only thing to be kept

of H.No. I can be thrown on House No.7 but planet of H.No.7 will not
have any malefic effect on the planet of H.No. 1. Keeping this in view,
the points emerging from the mutual effect will be as follows:

## Chapter 11 · Structure, Rectification and Kinds of Horoscope

**[p. 196]**

KINDS OF HOROSCOPE
Simple Rectification of the Horoscope
Prepare the natal chart in
accordance with traditional
Astrology and its ascendant be
assigned as H.No. 1. The position
of planets in different houses is
thus established. For a house,
horoscope allied things of each
planet or concerned blood
relations are taken into account.
For 'palm horoscope', first fix
the position of male planets
whose position is clear and write rest of planets thereafter. Now see the
ascendant at the time of birth and the effect of planets. Compare with
the events of past and the chart of the house. The planets posited in
H.No.l may be shifted to No.2 and No.l2, and the remaining planets
accordingly. Assess the correct ascendant out of them. If time of birth
is not known, Moon chart according to traditional astrology be made.
Assess the position/effect of male planets in different houses and search
the correct ascendant. Thus, rectify the horoscope by taking past into
account. Then only look for predictions. In accordance with the birth
horoscope, the sign number is written in the top most square of the
chart. This number is known as the Ascendant. In the Samudrik Shastra
(La! Kitab), this upper square has been named as House No.1. Other
houses are given numbers in an anti-clockwise direction.
For example DOB March 14,1936, Saturday, 05.00 A.M.
In traditional astrology, Aries to Pisces are the Signs. In Samudrik
Shastra (La! Kitab), instead of Sign name, H.Nos. 1 to 12 are considered
as given above.

**[p. 197]**

KINDS OF HOROSCOPE 197
1RADIDONAL HOROSCOPE IAL KITAB HOROSCOPE
1) First of all, a horoscope is formed without writing any numeral in
it. In the ephemeris, before each Sign No. time is written in hours
and months i.e., each date of every month, the time numerals are
given. Before frrst Sign, in each date, the time written is of morning
and the time written in front of each Sign is also the time of that
sign i.e., the period of that sign which would end on the scheduled
given time. After this, the succeeding Sign would start.
2) According to the given birth time, sign number of the birth time be
No.I! or Aquarius. ln the above horoscope the numeral 11 is
written in the uppermost rectangle. Other numerals with planets are
recorded in the rest of the houses after 11. It would appear that
Moon has been left.
3) In the horoscope, both the entry time in the house of Moon, before
the date of birth, the name of Sign is given. When Moon enters this
Sign, that time is written in periods and moments (Ghari/Pal}
which would be converted into hours and seconds.
4) The entry time given against Moon means that after the rising of
Sun, Moon would enter the sign at the scheduled time. Before that
time Moon is considered in the previous Sign.
5) The time of Sun rise is also given in the ephemeris. Thus, it can
be known, at what time Moon would enter the scheduled Sign.
6) According to this example, Moon has entered Scorpio from Libra

and would go to the succeeding Sagittarius. In short, Moon would

House No., such a horoscope becomes Moon Horoscope.
8) Ephemeris have been made on the basis ofChennai (Madras) local

The birth time was taken according to Chennai time. Thus, there

Astrology of Birth and Horoscope
If the House No. in which Moon is written is taken as H.No.l, that
would be as Moon Horoscope. According to the Lal Kitab that would
be birth horoscopy for ascertaining the events. Only numerals are changed.
The rest of the planets as placed in the birth horoscope are written in the
same manner.
Doubts
1) In astrology, the basis of a horoscope is Ascendant (rising sign) at
the birth time. The Ascendant is consistently remain the same
around 2 hours. Ascendant and fate for the children supposedly
born during this period would approximately be the same.
2) In the science of astrology, there is no consideration of Palmistry.
Doubts can be removed by assimilating horoscopes of both the
sciences-Astrology and Palmistry. It is also possible that both these
horoscopes may not be same. It would not be appropriate to consider
them as wrong. The difference would be that the traditional
horoscope would give personal account of that person which
horoscope of the palm (Palmistry) will tell the account of his
ancestors. In such a condition, the difference would crop up due
to the fatherly or motherly debt. The horoscope may not be
considered incorrect as for the horoscope of palmistry, one has to
remedy the debt. This difference may not be taken to mean that the
horoscopes of both the sciences are not to be reviewed to find out
as to why the difference has arisen. The objective, however, is that,
despite all possible scrutiny the difference still remains. The above

**[p. 199]**

given remedy would be helpful. The important thing, however, is
that the difference be eliminated. The right hand of the person
(Sun) denotes thlnking and self effort whlch apparently effects
results. The left hand (Moon) shows fate part of the elders whlch
is regarding unseen help. Same is the case with females, but from
the other hand. If anybody's right and left hands differ, the account
of both the hands be seen separately and the result of the effect of
both the hands be taken into account and final result is prepared.
In routine life the right hand will be more effective but the effect
of the left comes sudden whlch will certainly affect at the time of
Moon and Venus. The male planets-Sun, Jupiter and Mars show
their results more on right hand. The rest of the planets are
emasculated. Thus, on both the sides, these right and left hands
give their effect simultaneously. Generally, man's left side of the
brain functions more whose link is with the right hand. He functions
less from the right side of the brain linked with the left hand. Thus
if there is any line on the left hand and is not clear on the right
hand, the effect of that line is less as the man will never think of
generating that effect. Naturally, it is possible that its effect may
become apparent all of a sudden.

Whether Chart of Man would be Powerful or of a Woman
The horoscope of a man overtakes the chart of the woman after
marriage. The effect of the man's chart becomes predominant on the
destiny of both. A time also comes when man may die or leave, flee, lost
or one woman becomes wife of two men) then the own chart of the
woman is restored. In this way, so far one is a child, the influence of
the parents and the fruit of the earlier births is also effective.
With solemnization of marriage, the chart of the woman proves
helpful like Sign Effect. A woman may die (is lost, missing or leaves the
country, or another love affair starts or one is lost in the sensual pleasures
of the world etc). Various types of jerks in the fate appear. In short, the
meeting together of man and woman and separating will certainly cause
difference in the filed of destiny but at times without above things
happening, various scenarios of fate manifest but in less number and
that, too, at a time when in the food of such a couple, the waves of the
Saturn, or parental debt is persisting.

## Chapter 12 · Annual Predictions/Analysing Effect of Planets

**[p. 210]**

EFFECT OF PLANETS/SOME EXAMPLES
In order to find out the year wise account of the fate, if the exact
birth time, day, month and place are not known, annual predictions can
be made on the basis of a chart based on confmned events. Such
occurrences are happiness, (for example, the month, day and year of the
marriage), the birth/death of some blood relation, certain events due to
the effect of male/female planets or emasculated planets; birthday (as
Sunday/ Monday), the planet to which the man belongs or to which
planet his grandfather or self-constructed house belongs etc. The planet
in Ascendant, and if Ascendant is blank, the planet lord Birth Sign can
be taken. In short, whatever time and exact happening may be available
that may be taken.
Supposing the event of anybody's marriage is available. First marriage
(if married several times, the first marriage day would be reckoned) if
solemnized at the age of 17, it would mean that Venus started showing
its effect from the age of 17. If the year, month and day of the marriage
is not known and the day, month and year of the death of the first spouse
is known, it would be deemed as the expiry of the year of Venus. In the
general duration of each planet, the period ofVenus is ofthree years. If
the marriage was solemnized at the age of 17, planet of Venus started
from the age of l7 and it continued for 3 years i.e., upto the age of 19.
If the spouse dies.at the age of 17, the Venus expired at the 17th year.
Three years before the day of the death of the woman till the day of
death there was the period of Venus. For preparing annual chart, the
order of planets is as follows. First of all Jupiter, then Snn, then Moon
and the last 9th is the number of years of Ketu. For the years of general
duration of the planets, their periods and order are given. The total ofthe
general period of all planets is one circle of 35 years. Supposing any
body's Venus started at the age of l7, then other planets would be as
given below:

Time of General effect of each Planet
In order to see the period of general effect of each planet on the
concerned animate things, the year of that native may be divided by the
numeral in which House No. that planet is posited. The planet will show
its effect in residual numeral House No. Divide the year of life by 12 for
the purpose of planet in H.No.l, by 11 for H.No.2 and by 10 for planet
in H.No.3. For the remaining, divide by the numeral of the house in
which the planet is posited. In the condition of zero balance or in case
the renamed house number being blank, the planet concerned would be
counted to be having its effect in the house where it is posited.
