Analysing the Effect of Planets in a Chart
No assessment can be made on the basis of a single planet. Such
an exercise might be lopsided, incomplete and deceptive.
Supposing in a chart (A) based on traditional astrology, the Ascendant
is Scorpio (Sign 8) and has Moon and Venus in it. Sun-Mercury in
Sagittarius, Jupiter in Capricorn, Mars and Rahu in Aquarius, Saturn in
Cancer and Ketu in Leo. According to Lal Kitab (B) one would say
Moon-Venus in No.1, Sun-Mercury No.2, Jupiter No.3, Mars-RahuNo.4,
Saturn No.9 and Ketu No.IO.
Chart A Chart B
For conjoined planets, first see the effect of individual planets in
these houses and then their joint effect in those houses. At times, by
virtue of joint effect, different results come up. For example, if Mars or
Mercury is alone in H.No.S, their respective effect would be malefic.
But together, Mars-Mercury in H.No.S give benefic results. Similarly,
Venus in H.No.9 is malefic but Venus-Ketu joint in H.No.9 are benefic.
Take another case. Mercury H.No, 3 or Venus H.No.9 are generally
malefic like Mars (negative) but ifMars-Mercury joint are posited prior
to Venus, Mercury will combine the effect of Mars with Venus through
its route canal. That will make the individual productive. Despite indications
about being childless, the native would have issues. Similarly, if Venus-

**[p. 219]**

ANALYSING EFFECf OF PLANErS 219
Ketu are together in H.No.l, the native will not be able to procreate,
notwithstanding the fact that Venus in No.1 is evergreen and Ketu in
No.1 exalts Sun even if Sun is malefic. The effect of planets when
conjoined would be as given for joint planets. In other cases, they would
give their individual effects. If there are 6 planets in a house first look
for their joint effect of 6. Next see for 5, 4, 3, 2 etc., and then individual
effect.
It has been mentioned at various places that the native should not
eat meat, drink alcohol or indulge in debauchery etc., which means that
the native would be given to these vices and hence he is advised to
refrain from the same. When it is said that the mother would be in a state
of mourning, it would imply that mother's side (maternal uncles etc.)
would be in a state of destitution and destruction. The native would live
the longest life in his family, which would mean that other members of
his family would die early. Hence, one should carefully read the text,
ponder over the same and then speak with due care.
General Principle of Planetary Effect
Various planets are Sign Lords of different houses but the same
houses have fixed house Lord also. If a house is considered a building,
the sign Lord owns the foundation. Fixed House Lord owns the building.
The mutual relationship of Sign Lord and Fixed House Lord whether
friendly or inimical determines the disposition of the house. In case of
friendship, the benefic effect is supplemented. Other wise, in inimical
relationship, malefic effect comes. On top of this, the disposition of a
posited planet in a particular house also makes its effect. The net effect
would be determined by propensity of a posited (transitting) planet with
respect to Sign Lord and Fixed House Lord.
For example, for H.No.ll, Sign Lord is Saturn, Fixed House Lord
is Jupiter. If Rahu is posited in H.No.l 1, the net result will be destruction
of Jupiter wherever it is posited. H.No. I I represents entry gate to the
world and earnings of an individual. Jupiter is owner of the building of
H.No.ll which has made it as a court of Justice and religion. Saturn
being Sign lord provides the foundation of iron, stone, marble etc. Jupiter's
Court makes the building glow like gold. Saturn is represented by pitch
black colour and Jupiter by bright yellow. Rahu is an evil agent of Saturn.

**[p. 220]**

220 LAL KITAB
It is shining blue colour and like an elephant causing earthquake. The
presence of Rahu m the court of Jupiter turns the building from yellow
to blue/black. The earthquake shatters the building. There is no sign of
religious worship or justice. By mixing of blue with yellow, green colour
of empty sky (Mercury), dominated by black (Saturn), gets manifested.
Net result is destruction of Jupiter. The sky gets filled with smoke (of
Rahu) and atrocities of Rahu dominate the world. That is why, it has
been indicated that for Rahu in No. 11, one should wear gold. A native
with Rahu in No. I I is harmful, damaging and ill disposed to his father
(Jupiter). Jupiter's gold is turned to brass by Rahu.
The joint effect of Jupiter and Rahu makes an artificial Mercury or
empty sky. Jupiter controls both the worlds. Rahu controls the blue sky
and divides the two worlds. Hence combined effect is of king and a
pauper. One's fortune will fluctuate between extreme riches/power and
poverty/powerlessness.
The above are general principles governing effect as also illustrated
so.
Some Samples for Interpretation
In this system it is presumed that man's horoscope overshadows
his wife's horoscope. But there are certain exceptions. These are in
respect of unmarried girls, deserters, marriages with a person of other
religious faith (like Muslim, Christians, foreign nationals). In such cases,
the woman's chart may not be affected by her husband's chart. In such
cases, both the horoscopes would act independently.

Effect of Planets
Jupiter has an effective age of 16 years out of which it gives
benefic results for first 8 years. But after first 8 years, Saturn will
damage results of Jupiter. While Jupiter has no enmity with any other
planet, evil planets (Rahu-Ketu-Saturn) do pollute its results when they
come to H.No.2, or Jupiter's house. But when Jupiter is posited in house
of an evil planet, it maintains its benefic effects irrespective of effect of
the evil planet itself. In the current case, Jupiter is in the house of Saturn,
but it will give benefic results for its full duration. However, effect of
Saturn itself will be malefic which will start after effective period of
Jupiter. Thus malefic effect of Saturn will start after 16 y=s (age of
Jupiter) and last till 36 (age of Saturn) for 20 years. Since malefic effect
of a planet is manifested at l/4'h or \12 of its effective period, Saturn
malefic effect will manifest at the age of 18 (half of Saturn's 36 years).
Saturn cannot give malefic effect so long Jupiter is with it. Jupiter ends
at 16. Saturn malefic effects can last from 8 to 16 years.
Sun will be excellent for its items during its effective age. Since it
debilitates, the effect of Venus will prevail all along. Further, Moon which
adversely affect Venus by 25%, helps Sun in the same degree.
No planet has enmity for Moon. But Moon itself has inimical
orientation for Venus and Mercury. Moon being posited in the house of
Jupiter (No.2) gets exalted.

## Chapter 14 · Articles, Relations, Business/Profession and Other Miscellaneous Matters

**[p. 246]**

PROFESSION AND OTHER
MISCELLANEOUS MATTERS PERTAINING
TO DIFFERENT PLANETS AND HOUSES
In this chapter, articles, relations, business, profession and
miscellaneous matters pertaining to different planets and houses have
been discussed. Whenever a planet is benefic, its related things would be
beneficial/benefited. During its malefic condition, it is better to avoid
matters relating to it. Further items of various houses have been explained.
Whenever a house is blank, following charts could help in identifying
items related to it by establishing them, which can be awakened. It
should be borne in mind that whenever it is indicated that a planet in
a particular house has malefic effects, it would be advisable to refrain
from items relating to that planet. For example, Venus in H.No.9 generally
causes financial losses and hence, whenever in an annual chart Venus is
in H.No.9, if a white cow is purchased, it will cause heavy losses.
Similarly, if items relating to particular house are established, their benefic
or malefic effect will be as per transitting planet in that year.
For example Sun in H.No.4 gives a royal combination and hence
items concerning H.No.4 and Snn H.No.4 would give highly beneficial
results. It is reiterated that items assigned to 12 fixed houses and 9
planets will either be benefic or malefic.

## Chapter 15 · Residential House as per Planets

**[p. 265]**

Jupiterian House: An airy house not facing North-South. A
courtyard on one side of the house and not in the centre. A peepal tree
or a place of worship either be in the house or in close proximity.
Solar House: An East facing house meant to receive sunlight.
Courtyard in middle, water source on right side near exit gate and fire
place in courtyard.
Lunar House: A well, pond, flowing water inside/adjoining or very
near the house.
Venusian House: Opposite to Solar house. Entrance porch/entry
gate facing North-South having white plaster. Some part of house would
beKuchcha.
Martian (positive) House: Mars moves along Sun, Jupiter and
Moon are like sentry. A North-South house with entry gate Kuchha or
pucca (cemented or uncemented).
Martian (negative) House: A South facing house. Tree along
with the house and shade of a tree falling on it. Sweetmeat shop or a
furnace or funeral place nearby. Neighbours issueless, if not himself.
Mercurial House: Vacant ground around of a lonely house. Trees
with broad leaves. Jupiterean devoid of lunar trees around. If such trees,
are there it will make Mercury inimical. (Peepal-Jupiter, Banyan-Jupiter
Moon, Berry- Mercury)
Saturnine House: A bounded house opposing to Sun and facing
West. Dark room on right side, after entry. So long as there is no light
in this room, Saturn gives benefic effect. Possibily a big stone in the
house and entry steps are made of old wood. Perhaps having pillars too.
Rahu House: A big covered earthen hole on right side while entering.
Water exit at entry point of house. Opposite house is lying uninhabited
or its owner is issueless. House roof has changed many a times. A
furnace, source of smoke or dirty water pool in close proximity.

**[p. 266]**

266 LALKITAB
Ketu House: A covered house with the in flow of dirty air. Ketu
gives clues to windows and doors. May be open from its three sides. Not
more than three sons/grandsons in the house. A two way path nearby/
a fallen house in neighbourhood or a place for dogs to roam about.
Remedies for Residential Houses
\. If in a house a place for hearth has been made for some marriage
etc., its burnt soil should be thrown in flowing water. In such a
house, if a child with Mars In H.No. 8 is born, his birth will destroy
the family.
2. It is advisable not to have any idols at home. They better be in a
temple. Only pictures of God may be kept. If there is a temple in
a house, and a child with Jupiter In H.No. 7 is born, misery will
be fall on the family.
3. In the dark room (store) ofthe house there should be no inlet for
light. Such a skylight can cause havoc. If the roof of dark room
is to be changed, first cover it with a new roof and then change
the old one.
4. If there are any ditches/empty utensils for decoration, keep some
dry dates or sweet things in them.
5. One must have some kuchcha space in the house. If there is no
kuchcha space, establish Venus by keeping a earthem flowerpot in
the home by planting some plant in it.
6. A South facing house is inauspicious for women. The direction of
the house should be changed. Only a small inlet may be left there.
7. Planets in Houses from No.I to 9 show their effect on the right
side (from entry gate) of the house. For example it Saturn is In
H.No. 4, Sun No.2, the second room on right will be a place for
items of Sun (like grains, jaggery or Sunshine). Fourth room will
be of Saturn having safe, iron, wood, place of death of younger
paternal uncle. The doors/roof of this room would be made of old
wood. If in room No.2 (Sun H.No.2), Sun is established, Room
No.4 will be generally a place for the sick and ailing.
8. If according to annual chart, Saturn has benefic relationship with
Rahu/Ketu (by aspect or being conjoined,), Saturn will cause houses

## Chapter 16 · Individuals Dominated by Various Planets

**[p. 273]**

VARIOUS PLANETS
Jupiter
With dominant Jupiter, one will not have a small forehead like a
mouse; nor one will suffer from asthma or his nose will be cut. One's

finger of hand will be long and not cut/damaged. One's conduct will be
clean bereft of any passion or prejudice. One would not have hunter-like
temper.
Sun
Sun dominated person will have no physical deformity of any kind.
One's complexion will be wheatish, eyes like lion but not furious. Tall
and single bodied. Strong and tolerant. Face will be glowing with broad
forehead. One's left side would be more active and would step out left
foot first. Outwardly innocent but full of anger within. One's conduct

## Chapter 17 · Marriage and Progeny

**[p. 278]**

Mars joins two individuals together in matrimony. lt makes a maiden
into a wife. If Mars is positive (Mars gets support of Sun or Moon),
married life is happy. If Mars is negative, (Sun-Saturn together or Sun
unable to give support to Mars) married life (Venus) remains disturbed.
lt is like barren land (ofMars negative) without sunshine. Darkness (of
Saturn) dominates. Venus denotes a spouse, Husband for a wife and vice
versa.
Generally Venus is considered to ascertain the possibility of marriage.
However, Mercury (excepting Mercury H.No. 12) also causes marriage to
take place. In the annual chart, (keeping in view friendship/enmity and
aspects ofp lanets in the year) when Venus/Mercury gets friendly support
ofSaturn or ifSaturn is in H.No. I, that is the year ofmarriage.
Whenever Venus and Mercury are alone, it should be checked whether
Mercury is giving support to Venus through its route canal principle.
Marriage is brought about by the following combinations (in the aunual
chart):
1. Mercury or Venus in H.Nos. 1, 2, 10, 11, 12 and Saturn supports
by being in H.No.l, 10.
2. In birth chart Mercury or Venus in H.No. 7 but no enemies (Sun,
Moon, Rahu) in H.No.3 and 11 and Mercury/Venus come to H.No.7
in annual chart.

of the two is afflicted when together and Saturn alone or conjoined
is in H.No.2, 7 or 12, but none among the conjoined planet is
afflicted/destroyed.
4. If in birth chart Mercury, Venus is afflicted/debilitated but male
planets (Sun, Mars, Jupiter) conjoin with female planets (Venus,
Moon) and whenever Saturn in transit supports/aspects or Saturn
is in H.No.l
5. Mercury/Venus in the same house as in the original chart, provided
there is no enemy planet (Sun, Moon, Rahu) (excepting Venus

Number of Marriages
If somebody has Mars (negative), he could have as many spouses
as the number of houses in between Mars (negative) and Venus. If
Mercury and Venus are in separate houses then considerations of route
canal of Mercury and preceding and succeeding houses of Mercury,
Venus should also be reckoned. If in such a case if Venus is alone in
H.No. 2,4 or 7 (female houses) there would be only one husband. But
the man can be married many times-whether he gets marital bliss or not
is uncertain. IfMercury alone is in Nos. 1,5,9 or 12 (male houses) wife
would be one but she may have many husbands without fruits of marriage.
If in the above two conditions Mercury and Venus are in opposite houses,
the result can be reversed. Such multi-spouse situations come when
female planets/male planets are outside their houses and do not even
aspect their houses, or do not become companion planets of Venus or
Mercury.
One wife and happy family life
Married life is happy and one has only one spouse if
i) Saturn supports Venus and enemy male planet is not with Venus,
ii) Mercury and Venus are both benefic or exalted and Saturn aspects
Sun,
ii) Mercury is prior or in H.No.6 and Venus is not afflicted.
However, if Mercury is depressed, even if Venus is exalted, marriage
IS fruitful after 28 and male offspring are rare.
Wife who would lose husbands
If Mercury and Venus are though well posited but are both aspected
by enemies, and if Sun or Ketu aspects or conjoins Mercury, the woman
would lose her husbands after remarriages.

i) If Venus is debilitated or conjoined by enemies and Sun aspects
Saturn.
ii) Mercury, Rahu, Ketu and Saturn in HNo 5, 8 and/or Venus is in
HNos. 2, 4 or 7.
iii) Jupiter is debilitated in H.No.IO, and Sun in HNo 5.
In the above cases, one loses wife after wife.
If Rahu, Ketu and Saturn are posited on either side of Venus, or
Sun, Moon or Saturn alone or together are in the 4th or 8th house from
the house in which Venus is posited, spouse (Venus) would be burnt. In
such a case, donation of cow/bull will be helpful. Or if in a chart Venus
is alive or its friends Mercury, Saturn, Ketu are with it or in the adjoining
houses or support Venus by aspect, only one spouse is indicated. If
enemy planets damage Venus, one would have more than one spouse. If
Sun, Mercury and Rahu are conjoined, one would have more than one
marriage, but no martial bliss. IfMercury is in HNo.S, one would have
more than one spouse but all would be alive. If Mercury is in HNo.S or
Venus HNo.4 and House Nos. 2 or 7 are blank, one would have more
than one living spouses. Every time, during transit, if Sun and Saturn
confront outwardly, marriages will take place especially when Sun in
HNo.6, Saturn HNo. 12 indicate loss of spouses without producing a
child.
Complexion, nature of wife
One would have a powerful wife like an elephant, if Ketu, Saturn
Ketu or Venus is exalted. Wife would be like a deer, if Venus or Rahu is
with Sun or Venus or Rahu is in HNo.5 (of Sun), or HNo 10 (of
Saturn). Link between Sun and Mercury will give clue to nature and
complexion of wife. Wife will be noble and of fair complexion if Sun is
in prior houses (Nos. I to 6) and Mercury in latter houses (Nos.7 to 12)
provided Saturn does not cause any obstruction. If Mercury is prior than
Sun, Wife will be affected in her complexion and temper. If Sun/Mercury
are together or alone in benefic house for Sun, and there is no malefic
effect of Saturn or enemy planets, she will be excellent. Otherwise, wife
will be clever (like Saturn). Sun-Mercury in HNo.7 gives a wife from
richer family, (if Venus is good), otherwise wife will be from a poor
family.

Age of Couple
If Venus is alive or friendly planets aspect/support Venus, wife will
be long lived. Aspect of enemy planet will make her life short. If Mercury
is alive or aspected!supported by friends, husband will live long. Aspect
of enemy planet will shorten his life. Similar is the case, if friendly or
enemy planets aspect Mercury-Venus together. If Venus is aspected by
its friend (Saturn) and Mercury is aspected by its enemy (Moon) wife
will live longer and husband shorter. If Mercury is aspected by a friend
(Sun, Rahu) and Venus is aspected by enemy (Sun, Moon, Rahu), male
will live longer and wife would die earlier. If Venus is aspected by its
enemy (Sun, Moon, Rahu) and Mercury is aspected by its friends, male
will remain alive even ifhis wife may die. If Mercury is aspected by its
enemy (Moon) and Venus is aspected by its enemy (Sun, Moon, Rahu),
woman will live, though her husbands may die. If Venus is unafflicted,
native will have only one spouse. Sun H.No.6 or Saturn in H.No. 12,
will cause repeated losses of wife.
Fate, happiness etc. after marriage
The fate of husband and wife gets determined by relationship of
Venus and Mercury.
(i) Aspect/company of Jupiter (with Venus, Mercury) gives respect
and fate, Sun:-general conduct, life status, Moon:-wealth, age and
peace, Mars: -conception, Saturn: -property, Rahu: -unhappiness,
losses, enmity and deaths, Ketu:-pleasures, property and happiness.
(ii) If Venus is established, alive or gets help of friends there will be
long life of wife.
(iii) Mercury established, alive or gets help of friends will give long life
of male.
(iv) If both Venus and Mercury are established/helped by friends-both
will have long life.
(v) If Mercury, Saturn are together or Jupiter is alone in H.No. 10 -
male remains unhappy.
(vi) If enemies of Venus are in H.No.7, or Moon-Saturn are together,
or Mercury and Moon are together or Mercury is established but
Venus is depressed or MercuryNenus linked with Moon, Mars

Role of planets in Creation of Progeny
The Moon chart is not valid for consideration regarding conception.
Jupiter - Child birth is caused by Jupiter (artificial Sun-Venus
together). It is not considered for the survival of the child but provides
for soul of the body.
Sun- (artificial Venus-Mercury together) creates light in the empty
womb of the mother, enlightens the fate of parents by virtue of children,
brings light to dark homes and controls health.
Moon- (artificial Jupiter-Sun together) governs wealth, age, pious
relations with parents, etc.
Venus- (artificial Rahu-Ketu together) provides soil for the body,
family comfort, and facility of child birth.
Mars- [(artificial Sun -Mercury together Mars (positive) Saturn
Sun together Mars negative)] provides blood, capacity to procreate and
provide for generation of family line. For a person, it provides virility and
keeps the soul and body together. It keeps the progeny alive like growth
of a creeper plant.
Mercury- (artificial Jupiter, Rahu together). Controls relationship of
progeny with other's, creates and keeps womanhood alive, provides
imagination for virility, free space for interaction for self and children
with others, respect and honour.
Saturn (artificial Venus-Jupiter together, Ketu temper, Mars-Mercury
together Rahu-temper) determines time of birth, property, ill repute, disease
and death.
Rahu (artificial condition Mars-Sat (exalted) or Sun-Saturn
(debilitated)-causes conflicVquarrels, opposing/silencing Jupiter, blocking
entry of soul, causing death and delay in child birth, secret providential
obstruction, causing tremors. But helpful to girls.
Ketu (Moon-Saturn-debilitated Ketu, Saturn-Venus exalted Ketu)
provides happiness to children, their prosperity, restricting number of
male children, Ketu gives male offspring, if it is not aspected by enemy
planets.

**[p. 288]**

288 LAL KITAB
Desire for sex is created by Mercury, Mars provides strength for
procreation and Jupiter gives life to progeny. These three planets (Mercury,
Mars, Jupiter) are the three legs of Ketu. Together they form seed
(Venus). As the position/exaltation of these three planets, so the chances
of child birth. If Jupiter, Mars and Mercury are exalted, they will give
excellent results but if Jupiter or Mars are in HNo.6 or 12, and even if
Ketu is exalted, the net result is poor.
Birth of children
Venus, Mars, Mercury, Ketu and Saturn contribute to the birth of
a child. The period of child birth will be when male planets (Sun, Mars,
Jupiter) and Moon are in Nos I and 5, Mars HNo.2, and Ketu HNo.l1.
Whether it will be a son or daughter will be determined by position and
strength of Mercury and Ketu. If Mercury is stronger, it would be a
daughter. If Ketu is stronger, it would be a son. If Sun, Moon, Jupiter
or Saturn is in H.No.5 it would be a male child. IfKetu in H.No. 11, and
Jupiter, Saturn or Moon is in H.No.5 there will be delay in child birth or
the child may be born dead or there may be obstruction or difficulty in
child birth.
If Venus-Sun-Rahu/Ketu-Mercury-Satum are in H.No.3, 5 or II,
they will give a male child who will live long. IfKetu is alive it would
give son. If Rahu is alive, it would give daughter. Moon in 6th house
gives more daugthers and Ketu in H.No.4 gives more sons.
If according to a male chart, Moon is destroyed, it will as well
destroy progeny. 40/43 days before child birth, a white carrot and items
of Saturn and Rahu may be kept near head side of a pregnant woman
at night and are given by her in a temple in the morning.

JUPITER
(Lord Brahma, Creator of the Universe)
life has two shades - dark and bright.
Both come and go, and show their effect.
But when one's destiny is affected.
One suffers damage to eye, house, machinery,
And evil effects of enmity and snake bite.

I . The air locked in a man's palm and spread over the open sky with
capacity to move both the Worlds and the Universe; and also move within
and outside a man is called 'Jupiter'. In its closed form, it conceals the
secrets of destiny bestowed by nature. In its open form, it reveals
treasures of previous birth. It is the cause of birth and death of a man.
Jupiter is the Lord of both the Worlds and also the Master of all other
planets. Jupiter determines noble relationship with friends and relatives,
earnings, comforts from sons and parents, respect in the world, religiosity,
happiness/misery in everyday life and comfort from/to spouse. Due to
Jupiter, one earns with his wisdom, one gets power of royalty, intellectual
strength and lotteries etc. It is effective in 'intermediate stage'. To start
with, it gives results of Ketu, intermediate stage is of its own and latter
part is of Sun. Jupiter does not have animus for any other planet. In its
own houses or even in enemy houses, it gives benefic results for 8 years.
Enemy/evil planets in Jupiter's houses, (excepting H.No. 2) give malefic
results. While Jupiter has enmity for none, Mercury and Venus do have
animosity for Jupiter but the net result is their own destruction. With
Saturn, Rahu and Ketu, Jupiter are like melted gold, whose 'doubtable
position' can be exploited. Remedies of evil and Mercury are helpful.
2. Thus, while posited in a house, Jupiter is capable of giving both types
of extreme results depending on its orientation - benefic or malefic. It
can make a man like a King or a beggar, gold or brass, a great philanthropist
or a thief (a saint without qualms of conscience). Malefic effects of Jupiter
are reflected through items of Saturn and its own benefic effects are
reflected through Jupiterean articles, works and relationships themselves.
3. Jupiter is a first rate benefic planet. It is the lord of 9th and 12th
houses and is a significator of position; and if conjoined with other planets

**[p. 318]**

318 LALKITAB
or has any relationship with them by occupying their star sign etc., one
can make a judicious choice and cultivate habits, concentrate, meditate
and pray. When Jupiter and Venus conjoin or aspect each other, prosperity
is the result. Jupiter is for the upliftment of the soul, one leads spiritual
life without much attachment to domestic life. Its thrust is towards the
other world. Jupiter governs power. Its direction is North-East.
4. Benefic Jupiter - When Jupiter is benefic, it bestows on the native
geniality and generosity ,joy ,jubilation and joviality. One can expect respect
and good reputation during its period. Cooperation and congenial atmosphere,
progress and prosperity in life, philosophic and philanthropic conduct and
morals, peace, health and wealth, all are bestowed by benefic Jupiter.
5. Malefic Jupiter - If Jupiter is afflicted (by adverse company/
aspect) or is in malefic houses, the native will not be moderate but an
extremist. He will be very liberal, extravagant and even lavish. Over
optimism, false hopes, carelessness, debts, disputes and failure in speculation,
desperation, gambling and pressure from creditors, anxiety on account of
children, false prestige, large donations beyond normal capacity, vain
pomp, loss in reliance on others and standing surety for them, cheap
popularity, default and infamy, extravagance, gluttony, unusual girth,
misjudgment and miscalculations - are all attributed to malefic Jupiter.

**[p. 321]**

JUPITER 321
i) When conjoined with Sun and Mars (male planets) or aspected by
them, Jupiter converts copper into gold.
ii) When conjoined with Venus and Moon (female planets), Jupiter turns
water into milk.
iii) Without Jupiter, other planets do not have any capacity to give
combined effect by conjunction or aspect.
iv) If evil planets (Saturn, Rahu & Ketu) are malefic, Jupiter will give
malefic results. Gold will become brass, fresh air will tum poisonous.
v) Both Jupiter and Rahu are considered to be positioned together in
the sky (H.No. 12). While Jupiter has divine powers, it is Rahu which
provides Jupiter a blue inlet/outlet. Hence, as the Rahu (gateman) so the
Jupiter. IfRahu acts like a mad elephant, gives poisonous gas and shakes
the earth, Jupiter cannot give benefic results but an exalted Rahu or posited
before Jupiter (whether in natal chart or annual chart), makes Jupiter the
owner of the two Worlds. It gives divine results and spiritual powers.
Otherwise, Jupiter becomes domesticated, starved of money and deprived
of spirituality.
vi) If Jupiter is posited alone, notwithstanding malefic aspect of another
planet, Jupiter would never give malefic effects.
vii) If Jupiter has lost its strength i.e., it is affected by enemy planets
(viz. Mercury, Venus, Rahu and Saturn) or evil planets (Saturn or Rahu
or Ketu) join Jupiter anyway by position or aspect; in such an eventuality
Jupiter is like a blank Mercury and its conduct is determined by the
conduct of Mercury. However, Jupiter will be remediable, Remedies
of enemy planets would help.
viii) Rahu & Ketu cause irritations here and there and it is Jupiter which
controls Rahu and Ketu. Hence, if these two (Rahu & Ketu) are upto some
mischief, Jupiter would give out indication thereof through its articles/
business/relatives. The power of Jupiter to control the two worlds and
its capacity to give benefic results is destroyed by eclipse formation (Sun
Rahu/Moon-Ketu) or company of enemy planets (Mercury, Venus, Rahu
& Saturn). IfMercury-Rahu are together; or each one alone is in H.No.
2, 5, 9 & II, or Mars is negative or in H.No. 4, the effect ofJupiter will
be malefic. Jupiter in H.Nos. 6 to I1, makes the native a thief.
ix) Jupiter in H.Nos. 1 to 5, or H.No. 12 will help both Saturn & Sun.
Jupiter in H.Nos. 6 to 11 will only help Saturn.

10. Relations with other Planets
Sun
When Sun is benefic or it forms benefic aspect with Jupiter, Jupiter
gives the native a broad outlook, abundance, rapid recovery from even
severe illness. The native will earn the friendship of all by his cheer,
kindness and sympathy. He will never betray anybody. He will think
clearly, do his work ably and will judge properly. He will earn only by
fair means and it will never have 'tainted money'. He will not seek to draw
benefit by causing loss to others.
It Mercury were to give the native a promotion, then the higher
official will be transferred and that vacancy will be filled up by him. If
Saturn has to promote him, his senior may pass away, retire, be compulsory
retired, dismissed, demoted and the native will be promoted. If Jupiter
offers him a promotion in its period, there may be expansion in his
department creating a post and in the chain of promotions, he will have
his promotion also. His children and himself will be lucky, and have
excellent future and govt. support.
He may be religious and be one ofthe so many pillars of religious
society. An exalted Sun is extremely benefic for the subject and his
offspring and brightens his future.
Legal, finance, political, banking and educational departments and
institutions may be his profession. Posts of political office are offered
either by Sun or by Moon forming benefic aspects with Jupiter.
Moon
When Moon is benefic or it forms a favourable aspect with Jupiter,
Jupiter would give the native a noble, magnanimous and optimistic disposition.
He will be popular, honest and fair. As he grows, he will have good health
and his reasoning faculty of lofty ideas, with fertile and fruitful imagination
will improve. General success in life, no trouble through litigation. One
will not be extravagant and one will not take desperate chances in speculation
and gambling. Items made of Moon like fine white flour and aerial help
will be auspicious. Items made of gas/liquid will be helpful.
When Mars is benefic or Mars and Jupiter are in good aspect, Jupiter

found incontrovertible.

or import, editing, publishing, publicity, mathematics, banking accounts,
auditing, civil engineering may be his various occupations. Plurality of
interests is indicated by Mercury.

Sun is the name given to light in the sky, heat of the earth, magnanllnity
of the King, truth, rearing and prosperity. For an individual, Sun governs
royal position, owner, father, mental anxiety, own work, official work,
education, bones and palpitation of heart. Its presence makes the day and
absence causes night. It is the soul of the human body and gives strength
to help others. Coolness (Moon), heat (Sun itself) redness (Mars) and
empty circle (Mercury) are essential components of Sun. It is the foundation

Effect of Sun in 12 Houses
While in I st, it makes the native a King and philanthropist, gives
comforts in 2nd, unbounded wealth in 3rd prosperity in 4th. Gives sons
in 5th, but causes financial worry in 6th. May cause shortage of family

nights when in 12th.
House No. I
The native will give full help to father though he may not expect
anything from his son. May not inherit anything from his father but will
certainly leave behind inheritance. An impartial King. Strong but inwardly
kind hearted.
House No.2
Like the light of the temple. Religious, medium fmancial status, even
natured, a small time King. Will certainly give prosperity to friends, children
and relatives though he may not be so wealth. Service of Sadhus will
bring prosperity.
House No.3
Someone having strength to scare and deny death. Would himself
be rich and share his prosperity with others too. Harsh on falsehood and
bias. Mercury the Lord of this house would tend to make the jungles so
thick that Sun rays do not penetrate them but Sun will be so strong that
its heat will cause fire in the jungle. lt is obligatory for a person with
Sun in H.No. 3 to look after others too. Otherwise, he would himself
be destroyed.
House No.4
Positively a King, whether born in a royal family or not. He may
have started his life like a pauper but he will certainly make riches available

**[p. 365]**

SUN 365
to his children. His father may have wife like relationships with many
women but the subject himself would be of high character. The native
would prefer to suffer himself but will not allow others to suffer. If he
keeps any other person's wife, he will remain or become issueless. He
would have capacity to give pearls in alms.
House No. 5
A person who is a symbol ofhumanism. A respected King who will
make a temple out of his blood relationships. As he grows, so would his
wealth grow. Lucky by birth. Spendings will bring prosperity to children.
He would favour freedom for those in bondage.
House No. 6
A foolish King. Sun's heat does not extinguish even at night. When
a field of wheat goes afire, only one who gives milk in place of water
and blesses the wrongdoer even may survive. He would be obstinate like
a banished King. Foolish enough to see his subjects perish. He may have
to encounter misfortune but would never be evil hearted or foulmouthed.
House No. 7
His birth may raise false hopes but he may be unlucky to start with.
By his wisdom, still he saves himself from total destruction. As he
becomes self-dependent, he starts earning his bread and prosperity comes.
He still remains a King without a crown. Even if he is born in a royal
family, he will not be enthroned as King. He should adopt the policy of
strong approach in dealing with royal matters and softness in business
dealings.
House No. 8
He will stall death if he is present. Even if born in poverty, he will
rise to become a King. Nobody will harm him but whatever is lost will
not come back. If he is rich, his riches will grow. If he is a beggar, he
will not get alms. So long as he does not harm his own blood relations,
he will not get destroyed. He will have the disposition and strength to
review the dead.

368 LALKITAB
A chart having Snn in H. Nos. 1,5, or 11 becomes adult. Snn of
H. No. 1 will be helpful to planets with it whether they are its friends
or enemies. When Snn is in H.No. 5 or 11, other planets will themselves
come forward to help Sun; even if they are enemies of Snn. However,
if there is Sun-Rahu (Solar eclipse), Moon-Ketu (Lunar eclipse) combination
in the chart, no planet will give benefice results till age of 45.
Sun alone, even if debilitated or in a bad house never gives malefic
effect but instead, Ketu (son's fate, age, comfort to father) will become
a casualty. Fits of anger will cause destruction. Public service and
donations will remedy the situation.
Whenever Snn comes to H. No. 1, Venus becomes malefic but Snn
will be excellent for itself. In such a case, take help of Mercury.
Snn will not give benefice effect w .r.t. items of houses No. 2, 6,
7, and 8, l 0, II, 12 if posited alone in these houses but it does not imply
that its effect will be malefic. If Snn is with enemy planets (Sun-Rahu,
Sun-Saturn, Sun-Venus, Sun-Ketu) and in transit comes to the same house,
it will give malefic results. In such a condition, effect of enemy planets
during their periods will also remain malefic. Supposing Sun-Venus are
in H.No. 5. At age of25/34, the skin of wife will be adversely affected.
Help of Mercury should be taken but if friendly planets (Moon, Mars,
Jupiter) are also there, along with enemy planets and Sun, the evil effect
will pass onto items related to friendly planets in that house. If enemy
planets are in prior houses by position or aspect (1, 2, 3 numerically),
the effect of Snn will become malefic. If enemy planets are after the
position of Sun, the effect will be on enemy planets and their houses.
Remedy
If Sun's effect is malefic on other planets, improve friendly
planets (Moon, Mars, and Jupiter). When Sun is in H.No. 6, 7, the
remedy of Mercury will help and also by destroying Moon. (Extinguish
frre at night by throwing drops ofmilk on it). Whenever any planet
is being destroyed by Sun itself, then remedy Sun itself. When Sun's
own effect is being destroyed, then improve (purify) the planet which
is causing this damage.
If Snn alone is in houses Nos. 2,6,7,8,10,11,12, its benefice effect
will cease on items related to planets (Venus, Rahu, Ketu & Saturn) who
own these houses by lordship and exaltation.

## Moon

**[p. 397]**

Moon
(Lord Spiv0 Motber, Forest Land, Age)

**[p. 398]**

MOON
(Kind Lord Shiva, mother, forest land, age)
Moon denotes mind and mother. It takes light from Sun and is the
junior representative of Sun. While Sun may be hot tempered, Moon is
always cool and carries out its instructions peacefully. The self, body and
soul of a man (Sun); head (Mercury), eyes (Saturn); wife and family
(Venus), mother and mind (Moon); brothers-in-law (from wife and sister
sides) indicated by Mars is positive and brothers, preceptors and father
(Jupiter) all seek help of Moon.
It is generally believed in Hindu Astrology that the period after
Sunset, the first part of the evening is controlled by Rahu and last part
of the night before Sun rise is controlled by Ketu. In between period of
night is controlled by Saturn. Full night is denoted also by Moon, whether
waxing or waning. This Moon period is shared by Jupiter, Sun and Moon.
The evil (Rahu-Ketu, Saturn) try to mix poison in the milk (Moon) and
spoil comforts of night. So Moon's influence is over Jupiter, Sun and
Moon and also over Rahu-Ketu and Saturn. On this basis, effect of Moon
is analysed.
While Jupiter is Lord of all planets, Moon controls age (a)
It reflects effect of Sun in natal chart or transit,
Affected by enemy or polluted, still not destructive
Prior Jupiter and latter Ketu, both adversely affect Moon.
If Jupiter is prior to Moon, but no mixing by aspect
Moon gets spoilt resulting in discomfort to parents
Jupiter aspect benefits mother, older Moon effects later
Mercury prior poisons it, especially in H.No. 3, 4, 7, 9 (b)
Company of evil destroys Moon, affecting age and Venus (c)
Moon destroys Mars negative, blank H.No. 4 or lone planet excellent
Sun's aspect not from H.No. 1, fortune smiles 1/2 Moon age.
a) Moon effect is divided into three parts: Jupiter, Sun, Moon
b) Moon in H.No. 3 - Victory in battlefield
Moon in H.No. 7 - Wealth and prosperity.
Moon in H.No. 8 - Protection from death, long life.
c) Venus becomes useless like spoilt milk, A person with poor Moon
will not get benefit in Venusian works, but items of Moon will be
beneficial, Ice of water useful but ice of sky harmful.

become malefic.
Moon-Saturn relations
When Moon aspects Saturn, Moon will confer benefic results whereas
Saturn will indicate malefic effects and vice versa.
When Moon and Saturn are posited in different but adjoining houses,
they will act separately being inimical to each other. The effects will be
malefic. In such combination, if a house or an underground place is
constructed by demolishing the wall of a well, the malefic affects will be
like death ofthe mother, loss ofwealth and children. The native may also
be paralysed in half the body.
Moon-Rahu-Ketu
When malefic planets like Rahu, Ketu and Saturn or enemies of Moon
are conjoined with Moon or aspect Moon, it will become malefic and Ketu
will give unfavourable results. Profit through traits of Venus is not indicated,
whereas profits through trade or articles relating to Moon will be beneficial.
In such cases remedy of Moon should be done.
The evil planets (Rahu-Ketu, Saturn) will always pollute Moon. When
Moon aspects its enemy planets, it stops giving its benefic results. If
enemy planets are posited opposite Moon, the evil effect will be on near
relatives of the native but not on his own. (e.g., Moon aspects Sun, and
Rahu-Ketu, Saturn are in H.No. 5).
When Sun and Mars are conjoined in a chart, Moon is malefic. In
case Moon aspects Jupiter but Mercury, Venus, Rahu or Saturn are posited
in 2nd, 5th, 9th and 12th houses, Moon is malefic.

water taps, water tanks, (iii) Power of touch goes.

Malefic Effects
(Moon House No. 11)
Moon in lith House will give very ordinary results. Ketu wherever
posited will denote malefic effects. Ketu will indicate that the native will
not be blessed with a male child till the grand mother is alive. In case
one is blessed with a male child and grand mother sees him, it will be
inauspicious. Either grand mother will become widow or will be ruined
or the child would die. In case she is already widow or blind, one will
no doubt be blessed with a male child but at the age of 12 years of the
child or during Saturn period, either of the two will survive.
Remedy
In such circumstances, if there is a hand pump in the house
and a stone slab where the water falls, the mother of the child should
wash that slab daily or she should wash her head and eyes with milk
or should donate milk in Bhairon Mandir or temple. It will reduce
the malefic effects of Ketu.
For the long life of children, birth of a male child or for sexual
virility, one should take a bar of gold which should be put in fire
and on being red hot, be extinguished in milk and taken before the
time of intercourse. This process will be repeated eleven times and
one will be benefitted to the maximum extent.
In case one has rheumatic pain, the use of milk is unfavourable
due to some other disease but the use of above water in which gold
bar has been extinguished will be very favourable. The use of above
milk will increase the virility of the native or the medicine in which
gold or saffron has been used will also be beneficial.
I. Saturn in H.No. 3 Afflicted health of mother, worry, or

a) If the birth of a daughter falls on Wednesday or articles or business

the articles of Jupiter in the evening (Rahu).

To ward off the above evils, the mother should shift from
present place to another place at the time of birth of her child and
should never touch or see the child for 43 days. In case the wife
of native has her Moon also in 11th House, then the mother of the
native should also observe the above for a period of 43 days.

Relations ofVenns with Mercury
I) When Venus and Mercury are in opposite houses, they give individual
(debilitated) effect.
2) I fMercury is posited prior to Venus, their combined effect incorporates

if Mercury is malefic and in prior houses, Venus would not be able to
resist poison of Mercury resulting in adverse effect on family matters.
4) When Mercury & Venus are outside H. No. 1, 4,7,10and opposite to
each other, the effect of both planets will be poor. This happens during
when Venus in H.No.2- Mercury in H.No. 8, Venus in H.No. 3 -

5) When Venus and Mercury are in separate houses and do not conjoin
by aspect, Mercury would mix its effect with Venus through its route
canal and many times converts malefic effect ofVenus into benefic
but when enemy planets of Venus (Sun, Moon, and Rahu) are posited
alongwith Mercury, Venus will not allow Mercury to mix its effect in
it. That is, Mercury cannot spoil, pollute or destroy Venus when
Mercury is conjoined with Sun, Moon or Rahu.
Venus and its Enemies
Saturn and Sun are mutual enemies but when they are together, there
is no malefic effect. They even out each other but when Venus is posited
alongwith Saturn and aspected by some other planet, Saturn in such a case

Venus becomes malefic during transit, the enemy planets will pollute

MARS
Before delineating effects of Mars in different houses, some curious
but useful relationships of Mars with Saturn, Rahu and Ketu may be
considered.
Mars - Saturn Relations
Saturn is a dual planet for good and bad. Rahu and Ketu are its agents.
Saturn is more a friend than foe, provided one follows the path shown
by it, otherwise it whips sternly.
Saturn is also controller of eyesight. It gives power of quick perception.
Saturn is a friend of Mars but Mars is enemy of Saturn. Saturn in
Mars's House No. 3 becomes poor and ma}{es one penniless.
Mars is a good planet and a one track pusher. When a native is
addicted to bad habits or vices, then it pushes the native on that path.

**[p. 476]**

Mercury's Relationship with Rahu
Whenever Mercury and Rahu are together or Mercury is malefic
(generally in H.Nos. 3,8,9,12) and Rahu is malefic (in H.Nos. 1,5,7,8,1 1),
both will lead to imprisonment, madness, death or destitution even if there
is no fault or illness. Unnecessary and unproductive expenses will abound.
A ring of iron without a joint will be helpful. Mercury and Rahu would
be treated as joint if one does business/work relating to their joint items.
Mercury Sister, father's sister, mother's sister, wife's sister,
business.
Rahu In-laws, mother's father and mother, electricity, jail
deptt.
Mercury's Relationship with Ketu
Whenever Mercury and Ketu conjoin by aspect, Mercury's effect
remains unaffected but Ketu becomes malefic. Without Mercury other
planets also do not have flexibility.
General Connnents and Manifestations of Mercury
I. Works and professions of Mercury are : business, craftsmanship,
handicrafts, earning wealth with brain power upto age of 34. During
regime of Mercury, other things do not matter.
2. Mercury, which is full of poison, when in H.Nos. 1,2,4 does not
adversely effect its companion planet. It may be self-destructive but
will not cause any mishap. When in H.No. 3, it destroys other
planets. As it harms planets in H.No. I I, 12, they will cause further
harm like mad dogs.

Route Canal of Mercury
Normally planets in houses thirdfrom each other (like H.No. I
andH.No. 3) cannot meet but through Mercury's route canal, they
may get conjoined but will give benefic effects. However, they do
not conjoin for maleflc eff"ects.
Mercury and Venus together are very auspicious. H. No. 7 is their
joint house but when they are in opposite houses (7th to each other), the
effect of both of them is destroyed. If they are not opposite to each other,
Mercury will conjoin the effect of all planets in its house alongwith its
own effect with the house where Venus is posited but Venus does not
take the effect of its house to the house where Mercury is posited. Only
Mercury does so. In brief, during Venus period (Venus H.No. 1), the effect
of Mercury based house would mix with Venus based house but when
Mercury is in H. No. 1, the effect of H. No. I will not go to the house
where Venus is posited and all planets in Mercury based house will give
their respective effect.
The effect carried by Mercury, if posited prior to Venus will be
positive and benefic but effect carried by Mercury when posited latter than
Venus will be negative and malefic but if there are enemy planets of Venus
in the house where Mercury is posited. Venus will not allow Mercury to
carry the inimical effect to Venus house but Venus will not obstruct this
mixing if friendly planets of Venus are with Mercury. When Venus does
not get support from Mercury, it goes mad but Mercury will carry effect
of its house to Venus house if friendly planets of Venus are posited with
Venus.
Supposing in this process, Ketu is H.No. I and Mercury and Venus
are opposite to each other. In such a case, this combination will give
negative results. This will particularly be so ifMercury is in latter houses
than Venus. In such a case, Rahu-Ketu mix with Mercury-Venus and cause
havoc for the native during their transit to H.No. I but this may not be
the case when Mercury is posited prior to Venus. When Mercury or Venus
is in H.No. I, it will not be a malefic combination.
This positive route canal effect of Mercury has special significance

512 LALKITAB
for Mars. At times Mars does not seem to be getting help from Sun/Moon.

is with Mars, it is like a red necked parrot which will bring about
conjunction effect between Mars and Venus and give/save progeny by
Venus. In such a situation, the condition of Mercury being latter than Venus
will not remain valid. The benefic effect will remain since Mars will give
its effect to Venus during transit of Venus to H. No. I. The route canal
of Mercury thus has additional aspect than usual 100%, 50% and 25%.
It is so because Venus has mixed effect of Mercury in it. When Rahu
is with Mercury, Venus will not allow effect ofMercury to come into it,
go berserk and give results ofVenus HNo. 8. Similarly, without support
of Venus, Mercury will only give flowers and no fruit. One would have
sexual power but Mars will not support Venus in producing a child.
Teeth of Mercury
When teeth are intact, one would have control over his voice and
capacity to produce children because of Jupiter's power and support of
Mars but when teeth are not there, Moon will help. A child without teeth
gets mother's milk. When it gets teeth, it will get grains (Venus) to eat.
When Mercury is there, one can always expect help of Venus but when
teeth go, Mars is no longer in support of Mercury nor will there be
connection of Jupiter. The man/woman will no longer be able to procreate.
Secrets of Mercury
I . To understand role of Mercury, multiply house number with respective
strength of the planet in it, add all nine multiples and divide by nine.
If after division by 9, balance is zero, Mercury will give results of
the planet posited in H. No. 5. In this case, Rahu and Ketu get
entrapped in the circle ofMercury. Rahu and Ketu will not be able
to influence any other planet. Their power has become zero to the
circle of Mercury but respective effects ofRahu and Ketu will remain
intact. This is because effect of Rahu-Ketu is always there in
Mercury excepting in H. No. 4, wherein Rahu-Ketu have resolved
to do no evil. IfRahu be taken as key of a watch, Ketu is the dog
of the watch. Both are moved by Jupiter but they do their movement

JUPITER-SUN
(Royal Wealth, Artificial Moon)
Jupiter and Sun together control all the Three Worlds.
Jupiter is father, Sun his son, together bring fortune.
Each heralds fortune, own effect, together form Moon.
In H. No. 7, they are doubtful and form Father's Debt.

When Jupiter and Sun are together, one's destiny shines. Their
interaction will give benefic and spiritual benefits. One would achieve
success in worldly life. Sun will be 3 units and Jupiter 2 units if artificially
mixed. The effect of Jupiter will precede effect of Sun. Together they
form artificial Moon. Their effect on fate, speed and glow will be of a

son. When one is unmarried, his father's and when he gets a son his son's,
fortune will supplement his own. The two planets individually may be
malefic, but when together, they will give only benefic results. Benefic
effect for father-son will be in the following years.

a) IfRahu-Ketu are in H.No. 4, both Mercury and Saturn are benefic.
According to traditional astrology, Rahu and Ketu cannot be conjoined
in position; but only do so by aspect in the latter house where second
evil is posited. For example, if they are posited in H.No. l and 7, they
would be considered conjoined in H. No. 7.
However, this condition of Rahu-Ketu being l to 7 from each other
does not hold for a chart based on Oceanic Thought. They can even be
together. Whenever they are separate, wherever they are together by
aspect, their combined effect for that house will be considered. Based on
this principle, their conjoined effect for 12 houses has been given.
Disrepute, bad times (given by Rahu) would be indicated by Mercury,

**[p. 728]**

728 LALKITAB
but down of good (by Ketu) would be indicated by Jupiter. Rahu is secret
evil and Ketu is open evil. When Ketu is in prior houses and Rahu in latter
houses, Ketu will be zero and Rahu will generally be malefic. Rahu is tied
with Jupiter in the sky of H.No. 12. Ketu is with Mercury in infernal
subterrain of H. No. 6. Both are agents of Saturn in H.No.8. H. No. 2
is outward gate of the world. Both Rahu and Ketu form artificial walls
which are not permanent, but are collapsible. Their effect is obliterated
when eclipse goes. After removal of eclipse, the eclipsed planet comes
to its full form.
Rahu or Ketu whichever is in previous houses (H. No. 1 to 6), will
mix its effect with the other in latter houses (Nos. 7 to 12). From the
consideration of aspect whichever planet is latter would have benefic
effect. But there is no guarantee of good conduct of planet in prior houses.
Both give malefic results in H. No. 5 and 11 since in these houses, there
is no consideration of aspect effect, but there will be no effect on adjoining
houses (No.4, 6 and No. 10, 12). Rahu is chopped head, Ketu is headless
body. But in human body, portion above navel is of Rahu and below navel
is ofKetu. The headquarter ofRahu is the chin and Ketu's station is the
foot. Their front seat is thumb of the hand, H. No. 2 (place for Tilak
on forehead), anus (H. No. 8). Both give evil effect at these locations.
Such evil effects are unfortunate events, evil acts, unnecessary allegations,
disrepute, turbulence in family life etc.
Rahu-Ketu together form artificial Venus. When they act as agents
of Saturn, they are known as the evil. Matters relating to family life, airy
power, business of inanimate objects, diabolical conduct of women, evil
deeds in a religious place are all centered in H. No.2. As agents of Saturn,
in relation of animate objects, their location is in H. No. 8 which is the
gate of death. It is a place of joint operations by Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.
Rahu-Ketu prepare their statements in H. No. 2 announce the decisions
of Saturn in No. 8. Both move within the circle of Mercury. As the
Mercury, so their conduct. They will move around Mercury. Both planets
or alone in No. 4 or with Moon make the native religious and tolerant.
Evil planets will not have their effect. All planets will be religious.
To test Rahu, do remedy of Moon. Keep a piece of silver with
you. For Ketu do the remedy of Sun. Keep Sun item (like a copper
coin) with you; or feedjaggery to a monkey or throw jaggery, copper

CHART GIVING PLANETARY POSITION
WITH RESPECT TO AGE
The matrix given in the coming pages is used for preparing the
Annual chart according to Lal Kitab. The numbers shown from 1 to 12
are the twelve houses of the natal chart and numbers from 1 to 100 are the
age of the native.
Prepar the natal chart according to Lal Kitab (C-11) as told in the
introduction section of this book by giving the ascendant as House No.1
and remaining Houses as 2, 3 in the anti-clock direction.
The age of the native is calculated from his date of birth. Now for
preparing the Annual chart, first see the number of his/her age in the chart
in the line of age for which year Annual Chart has to be prepared. Now
write the planets of the chart as per the corresponding numbers in front of
the age below the House. For example, for date of birth 17. 9. 1970 the
annual chart would be as C-lll

## Practical Examples

**[p. 760]**

PRACTICAL EXAMPLES
According to the rules given in the two volumes ofLAL Kitab we
now work out a practical example in detail for the guidance of our esteemed
readers to enable them use this field of occult science and understand the
methods of interpreting the horoscope and advising remedies.
Date of birth · 05.09.1962 (AD)
Day ofBirth • Wednesday
Time of birth 10:29:00
Place of birth • Patiala (Punjab, India)
Traditional horoscope Lal Kitab's Horoscope
While interpreting the horoscope prepared through traditional
method, first rearrange the horoscope as per the method told in the Chapter
12 of the Lal Kitab Volume -1 by giving the Houses as No.I, 2 and so on
in anti-clock direction. It may be noted here that No.1 in House No.1 does
not mean Aries and No.2 Taurus. In Oceanic Knowledge, while interpreting
the horoscope, La! Kitab had given no reference of constellations and
Signs (1942-edition-page 334) and houses are counted from the ascendant.
Moon Chart also may be prepared according to the method told in the first
volume. Here we would like to again underscore that Moon chart would
not be that much effective before marriage ofthe native (male) but after
marriage Moon chart would give its full result which is considered the fate
brought in by his wife. On the principles ofLal Kitab Astrology, first we
would prepare a chart having details of relations between the planets which
would be helpful in interpreting the horoscope.
